The game play is fundamentally great. So simple to understand yet so many layers of interactions, timing and transactions makes the game play very fun and makes you feel very skillful. However, progression is a slog (it took me 2 years to get to max), updates are very infrequent and underwhelming at best and there really is only 1 way of playing the game. I deleted my supercell account along with 4 years of experience and its been awesome.

The game at first was great. I have played it for 6 years. Until the continuous updates, unnecessary characters and excessive cash payments. Once you don't have money for a card upgrade , you will LOSE a Battle and trophies. Another issue the game has is this buggy feature during Clan Wars. You attack an enemy boat and their health bar for the cannons are still intact. Overall, the game used to be great, but NEWER ISN'T ALWAYS BETTER.

This is a good game... If you have fast internet. The game itself can be played with slow internet but the problem comes when you load into a match. You see the game doesn't check if it's loaded for you before starting the match like games such as League do. Instead it just starts it and if your game takes a bit longer to load than your opponent's, they immediately have a major advantage.

Came back to the game after a year or so off only to find the micro transactions are worse. Every screen has a call to action. Elite wildcards, diamond pass, gold pass, 3-4 shop offers, events, etc. It used to be a fun game and the only reason I left in the first place was because of IRL events. Now it has become your typical mobile game. Sorry Supercell this is not for me.

The new vault mode in clan wars is one of the most idiotic, stupid, and uncreative things your team has done in a very very long time. Aside from that, the classic war deck mode is unfair, often giving one player cards that do not counter the other player's deck. If you can fix this, I'll change it to 5. After two years, I still wish there was an option to give zero stars.

EDIT: The addition of the pass has made this a completely subscription-based game. Realistically, you don't pay-to-win anymore... you pay-to-play. Non-sub players are at such a disadvantage it is basically not optional. While it seems possible to remain competitive without paying money, the reality is that you will always be behind anyone who does. This is because of the mechanic by which you can buy the cards themselves rather than opening the chests.

This game is really great. I've been playing since the game game out. Back when clans costed gems to make and when Legendary cards weren't a thing. I'm running a successful clan that wins wars almost every time and I am passionate about this game. However, the recent update as majorly impacted the experience of playing Clash royale. A lot of people I know can not access Clash aroyale anymore and every time I go to initiate a battle, the loading screen takes about 15 seconds which is drastically impacting my gameplay as enemies are taking out my towers before I even actually enter the game. Another issue that is really intoxicating for everyone is the new trading system. A lot of people are complaining stating that its "a MonEY GraB" and so on. My clan is filled with over 30 trade requests because trades have become so complicated and poor now. This was a really good game but I am afraid it will plummet into failure if you do not reverse the changes or recreate them in a way that suits everyone. If you read this, thank you for your time. This is a really good game but has had a devestating update.

Clash Royale is a very sloppy designed game, with very lackluster created characters, and very few updates, and when there is one, it always seems to be filler and doesnt actually produce anything productive for the well being of the game. While there are some times where Clash is kind of enjoyable, however, those moments are vastly overshadowed by the extent of said lackluster characters and very, very, VERY poor game design. I would never recommend it to my worst enemy in a million years.

Very pay to win, but it can still be kind of fun. Edit: It was 3 stars, but it's now so P2W that I can't progress at all. I'm not a bad player, I do decent in challenges. But I don't have the money to sink into all the evolutions. To be able to play multiple decks. Dagger duchess is what pushed me over the line. There are no more wild cards in the season shop, so unless you want to spend money enough, losing 1/2 the games because your tower troops are under levelled.

This game used to be one of my favorite games, i myself have played it for about 6 years. but the game seems to be going on a downhill trend, especially with the nonstop monetization, introduction of level 15, gold shortages (as mentioned by other reviews), and the nonstop release of dumb evolutions which are very hard to play against. I hope this game improves in the future but for now it seems to be going in a very concerning direction.

The game is great on a technical basis. There are very few bugs, the large variety of cards function as they are described, and there are several interesting battlemodes. But with all fun aspects of gameplay considered, some of the out-of-gameplay core mechanics are just fun killers. Since cards and towers are leveled, if someone has cards many levels higher than yours in a fight, they have a significant advantage. So, either you buy more cards with real cash, or painstakingly collect them. 👎

This has become a pay to win game. Subscription for bonus chests and other benefits. If you don't spend money, you will have a hard time winning. Edit : I decided to try the game again. After playing for a week, good internet connection, i am placing cards and the game is waiting 3 or 4 seconds before placing the cards after i tried placing them. Impossible to win any matches like this.

Used to be a good game, but has quickly went downhill. It's extremely pay to win. The new cards are extremely overpowered and it takes WAY too long to upgrade one card to max. For example, I've been a free to play player for about 6 years and don't even have one card at max level yet, but someone can easily upgrade all their cards if they are willing to spend some money. Very unfair matchmaking too. It puts you up against players who are 3 or 4 levels higher than you.

This game was fun. WAS. But this new update completely taints my opinion of the game and shows what it really is about. Yes, the pass royale is pointless and was horribly implemented, but the fact that the game is becoming less and less playable as it goes on speaks volumes to Supercell's intentions. Patching a few of the sometimes years old bugs isn't enough. I have spent money on this game, got to 4K, but this game has become a money grubbing unplayable mess. Good riddance.

Played for 8 years. They decided to make the game a fully pay to win game. Nearly no progress can be made if you were maxed level 14 when the evolutions came out. Been using the same deck for years, so has many people. Now everyone is forced to find a deck, hope that it stays relevant by the time you get the evolutions or level 15. Game used to be fun, challenging, easy to pick up at any point without feeling like you're playing a new game. Loved the game, until money became the main priority.

Editing my review from 4 years ago... The matching system SUCKS! I get either players too tough or they're able to bring out 3-4 characters at a time but yet, I have some of the same and it won't let me go that fast. What gives? Definitely set up pay to win! Could be fun if you stood a chance but you can't keep up and then have a time for them to go yet they take most your life before forming? Yeah no, I'm through with this! Long time player no more!

I love this game so much, and I would rate it 5 stars in a heartbeat, but I have encountered a major flaw. My phone isnt that great, so at the beginning of a game it can take up to 30 seconds to load into the match. In those 30 seconds, I've usually lost a tower or even gotten 3 crowned. It makes it impossible to climb, impossible to participate in clan wars and impossible to participate in events and challenges. Please just add a feature where the game doesnt start until ALL players are loaded.

EDIT - Game is still fun to play, is still dynamic, is still strategic. But the company has shown time and time again a disconnect from players. Clan war refactor was atrocious, and even if they took some steps to correct it, I still think it shows a stubbornness to stir back at unpopular changes, and the new upcoming addition of a new card/tower level that adds nothing other than just grind, and the dishonesty of announcing it after an event that nudged players at spending gold is a bad omen.

it's a fun game I do enjoy it, the only thing I don't enjoy is the game says it matches you with an equal opponent's trophy count, but the algorithm to me is similar to a slot machine. It allows you to win by not comparing the experience but just the trophy count, (which is how they get away with it), but the games ultimate intentions is all for the money, so the more you play the more you lose so that you can spend money on the game to increase your chance of winning. The match making is a lie.

I think its a pretty good game, but when the game updates and I realized when I saw other reviews I went to the options menu and clicked 'From this device model only' for the reviews and it seems the game only works for Apple products, and me having an Android the game just crashes and won't let me play. So if you could fix it so it would work for androids too I would appreciate it. Overall Great game

It is just a pay and play game. You can play for free for the initial level. But after certain level,you'll not get enough cards to level up untill you pay up. The match making also is very illogical. Also the server get disconnect a lot of time in between games. Especially when you play a limited entry matches. Pathetic.

The gameplay, graphics, and mechanics are awesome. There are several issues... In battles you will usually face decks that are clearly superior unless you get VERY lucky and get two or three good rare cards. Also, the chest times and limitations are ridiculously high opening one chest every three to twelve hours, and most of the upgrade cost past level four is so expensive, you'll be playing for weeks to upgrade even common cards... Clans cost way too much money to create. VERY disappointing.

Game takes way to long to be able to upgrade your cards. It always matches you up in unfavorable matches. Also, there is sometimes a lag at the beginning of the game that lets the other player get a head start on you and by the time the lag is over its pretty much to late and you lost. Other than that its a fun game that lets you pass time.

It's gotten pretty bad lately. Been playing since day 1, but I'm considering ending it here. Update: I took about a year break and came back and it was even worse. The game is riddled with constant "new" additions and updates that overcomplicate the game. The evolutions keep getting added to more and more cards making it honestly less and less fun. It's to the point where anyone new has to pay to play to keep up. I've been here since the beginning and I feel like I need to pay to play tbh.

I've been playing the game for like 6 years now. It use to be my favorite game to play, but here lately (actually for a little while now) it just seems to be going in the wrong direction. It's become less enjoyable to play over the last several updates. I think it's unbalanced and has several unnecessary parts. There are like two ladders now. This last update has really made less enjoyable.

I play very casually, usually coming back for a couple weeks every year before I stop again. I'm still disappointed by the lack of variety in the ranked game modes. Everyone is running the same/similar decks. This game has so much potential, but the lack of *REQUIRED* balance updates usually means running into the same types of decks against Enemies with the same play style. There's unfortunately no variety and as a result very little fun for casual free to play gamers.

My review still has not changed. Fix your game.. The way they set you up should be by level not trophies. that way it's more of a fair fight and you don't get screwed over by some one with a level 6 vs a level 3. The chest should have shorter timers then they have now. It shows that it is a pay to win. What made clash of clans fun was it was not a pay to win game. Guys step your game up for me to give you more stars.

I have played this have for a few years. It has increasingly become loaded with all sorts of ads and purchases which I can handle to an extent. But now the gameplay is affected with the evolution cards. If you don't pay for all of the add-ons and packages, it is harder to compete on the same level. Good for them for making money, but it sure makes the game less fun. Unfortunately I am uninstalling this game now. I guess it will free up some wasted time.

I'm getting game lags and slow connectivity always when i open clash Royale which was not fixed still even after a year. It's not fun anymore. And another thing is that i often get low connection icon although my internet speed is super which often lead to loss. I'm starting to wonder if there's a crack game that messes with the actual game, to also note that it's happening over and over. I'm in love with the game but this right now is a heart break. I hope they really take care of their game.

It's become a pay-to-win game. I played it since it started and I really enjoyed it until the pass appeared. Now that I see a player using a different tower skin, I know this player will probably have better cards than me. I don't plan to spend money on a mobile game; I've done it before and I found it a total waste. Please try to match players according to their "paying status", so things are fair again.

Great game, though the developers have focused too much on more bells and whistles to get your $$ more than improving game play. I'd say 75 percent of the time you get paired against a direct counter for your cards making skill meaningless. I miss the royal of old. They should have left well enough alone but I guess that doesn't make you rich. :( From 5 star to 3 New update as of 3/31/22 is too much. QUIT ADDING BS! It's getting too convoluted. It's overwhelming

Used to be one of the best mobile games, but for the past few years the game has become so pay-to-win, if not at the very least money-oriented, that even the whales have a hard time catching up. It's no longer about the cards or the gameplay, but on how much higher we can make the upgrade levels and costs to the point where any skill-based matchups get nullified. Anything that made the progression easier and simpler has now been removed or nerfed heavily. This game doesn't respect your time.

Mobile games like this only solidify the fact the PC and console gaming will always win out...this whole greed thing the world has fallen into is crazy...get ahead by spending real money on a bit of coding?! Lol you have to be kidding me I don't mind spending $50-$60 on a full game with plot and loot, etc, but I wouldn't spend a dime to get a digital card and if you don't you don't move up easier to loose trophies than gain and again unless you buy you never see the higher arenas or the characters that come with them. So yeah...there's my bit

Game play is cool, but dropping players trophies doesn't make any . What's the point of earning them when you're going to take them and drop them a level? I've earned a lot of the cards playing on different levels, so you can't use that argument. Moreover, you shouldn't loose trophies when you have glitches & connection issues. The developers should've thought about that since it's a live action game. What if players are in the middle of a battle and some where down the line poor reception causes

It makes me sad to see yet another game consumed by supercell's love for money. As if in app purchases weren't enough, adding the "battle pass" or whatever allows people to significantly further there process in the game with card upgrades and resources than people who don't pay. Now, you see level 10's with Max level cards and the entire leveling system on its own means absolutely nothing. I used to love this game but now it just sucks, like really really sucks. Save your time and money!!

I had a bit of fun, trying to catch up to and best friends, challenging myself to see how far I could get without spending money. The answer was two level 14s (max at time), which took a year and a half, and 5600 on ladder. They'd been making improvements, extra daily rewards, and it was possible to get the later card thresholds with books of cards and chests from the free battle pass. Then they scrapped the books and free battle pass. Good luck not paying, I'm out.

Those saying it's a money grab lack skill,patience and understanding. Been playing sense the release, got frustrated several times. Then I realized some people are just better than me. Yea it takes time to max out your cards , but it's not impossible and can be done without spending. Like ANY game with in-app purchases, spending just speeds up the process. Learn to realize , good things come in time.

It's a great game. No doubt about that. I've bought a few pass totaled on one account. The problem is, it randomly signed me out if that account and it won't send any verification codes for me to sign back in. I list my email and it says it's sending a verification code and nothing is in my inbox. I've lost an account that I put years into and I can't get it back. I can't get any account back.

I'm dropping down my rating to three stars due to the game becoming more a pay to play game. It is very easy for a lower-level player to buy a lot of stuff and become so darn good at the game because your troops are higher level then people that are two levels higher than you. This is extremely infuriating when I'm someone who's put a lot of time in this game and then run into someone who's a level 11 and I'm a level 13 and have level 13 troops whereas he has level 14 troops. :(

I've spent 2 years playing this game. Spent a couple hundred dollars. Played on fully maxed out accounts (My personal best is 6683 and I have 400k cards won). Supercell has turned the game into an absolute money grab, and I feel like my only way to retaliate for them killing a game I loved so much is to rate them low and quit playing it. There were good times here don't get me wrong! But now I just can't put up with it. Not the same game anymore. It's going in a downwards spiral too with no hopes of it getting better. Good luck to anyone who wants to bother with it.

I've been playing this game for a while and the game has always been balanced for the most part... recently I've noticed a bit of a change and today I played a match on my new phone (so since I don't want to link my account to Facebook I started a new acct) where my opponent was 5 levels higher than me and all their cards were much higher. :-/ great game though, can't wait to see where you go with it.

My original review was 3* and then I took it up to 5 in May of 2016. The devs really listened and made good changes and additions. Lately, it's been going downhill fast. They are emphasizing profits over the quality of the game. Players who don't shell out real $ are more and more disadvantaged when it comes to the ability to level. You get a LOT less gold these days if you don't subscribe to Pass Royale. I have been having fun with it lately though, so back to 4 stars.

Once I wasn't able to play 2 vs 2 because "I left many matches", the thing is that it was the game who left it, it crashed so many times, and still happening, that did not happen before, now I get very frustrated while playing because of many glitches and other things like balace between players, sad because i really liked the game but you had done few things to resolve this

I think we should have the option to choose a deck we want to go up against in the training mode. I put decks together to counter others and I use training to rehearse and anticipate what I go up against. The AI in training right now doesn't help much and the least we can do is put decks together that we normally see in a battle. Decks are stronger now with these new upgrades to the point where it is a bit unfair at times. Hopefully your team looks at this & consider this as an option.

This game wants your money, and, like most other mobile games, it's going to try to suck it out of you. If you want to play for free, expect a lame, limiting free pass (oh, and a battle pass system, but you'll know that soon enough), rigged matchmaking avoidable only to payers or long-time payers (you'll get put against some players with hefty card rarity, level or castle level advantages) and a very time-consuming path to upward progression. It's a shame, as the game was fast-paced fun.

This game gets more hate than it deserves. The graphics are good, no ads, and lots of free loot. The gameplay could use some balancing and the amount of trophies won/lost should be reworked so you don't get completely stuck in a certain tier. (Like me lol) I frequently face opponents with max troops and higher level castles which is very hard to compete against. But there's a good variety of game modes and clan wars can be fun if you find an active group.

This is why I will never invest in this game unless you're like them. This game is a cheat, when you figure out how to beat most of their line up, troop movement slows down and elixir generation slows down too then in the middle of the game, disconnects and re login you and you can never win any match when you see 'Reward limit reached'. And they clearly don't want anyone to reach 4000 trophies without any payments. Overall it's pay to win. What a great cheat game. In summary, MONEY TALKS..

As somone who's played this game since it came out, I have to say I'm very disappointed in what it's become. It was always a pay to win game, but it could be played with friends and you made it fun. Unfortunately the matchmaking still sucks. I wouldn't give it 2 stars for just that tho. I tried logging into my supercell id and it didn't let me. I want blocked and if I was, I should've been notified. I promise, when too update your game a lot of people will come back, just fix it, please!

After playing the game for over 3 years now I can not rate above 1 star... Game is all based on spending money in order to win (pay2win), the match system is unlikely to be fair, for example I myself am level 11 and fight against level 12 players etc.. This happens in order for players to pay for in game items of course. Overall I rate it with a single star because of the reasons mentioned above but also the lack of new updates that bring hype to the game.

The complaints about needing to pay to win were unfounded until this update. The 5 dollar pass, while optional, is thrown in your face. When you get a crown chest, you're forced to view the "elite reward" that you can only get by buying the pass. Essentially, the app is now structured to show you what you're missing out on instead of letting you enjoy a free game that gives you the option to buy extra goodies. As a long time player who has spent money, I'm really upset.

Best. Game. Ever. I've played this game for 3 years, and it still seems to amaze me in every way possible. New stuff almost every month, new and old challenges, clans, and much more. I highly recommend playing it. Trust me, you won't be disappointed. Editied: nevermind. This game gets boring after doing the same stuff for 5 years. There's really no variety and it's turned into an even more microtransactional hell then it already was.

Been one of the biggest proponents and defenders of this game for the longest time, my playtime is over 21 DAYS total, could be more by now, my account is probably 6-7 years old, and I've played on and off since launch or near launch, been so long I can't remember. Something I do remember is how much fun the game was, how over the last couple years the inconveniences and pay to win features have really stacked up. To be frank, the game is dying and they are milking whats left of the player base.

I like this game a lot. I actually started playing it just about everyday outside with my fiance, we both have separate accounts. Sometimes the internet is the hardest thing.... Once it starts lagging I can't see any of my "cards" and by the time it fixes itself I've lost already. Wouldn't suggest kids under 12 to play, as in the chat they can be pretty vulgar. But in all very addicting game hands down!

Game used to be fun, but it way to much diverse in the number of cards in the game. One minute, you destroy your opponent, the next you're in a good battle, then you go on a 7 game losing streak of just getting hard counted out of your mind and unless you have spent tons of money on the game to get more card and change your deck you get stuck partially at higher level arenas. The game is very skill based, which is great, but sometimes it literally doesn't matter how good you are you just loss.

Editing my review from 2016 to one star. I've been playing this game since it launched. It had been the one game I put money into each month. And was happy to do so. Now they have doubled the monthly price for the game pass and made some curious gameplay features. I completely understand that an established game needs to attract new players but not at the expense of long time existing ones. I was a play every day kind of user. Most days was logging in multiple times as well. Not now...

THIS GAME IS EXTREMELY EXPENSIVE. IT COSTS THOUSANDS OF DOLLARS TO PLAY PROPERLY. I keep losing to people blatantly because they paid money. I'm only in the middle of the progression system. It will only get worse as I go. Apparently now they're adding a new level that either costs thousands of dollars, or takes literal years of constant gameplay to unlock. I don't want to waste money on a phone game. I play better games on my PC all the time. This is a fun game to play when I poop, at least.

It's a fun game that I have been enjoying longer than any other mobile game. I especially like that the games are quick so I can play a quick match whenever. Deck building is great. I don't like the move to a season pass it makes it feel even more pay to win than it did before. At 5 bucks a month it's just more than I am willing to pay. But I have a lot of clan members that like it and continue to pay for it so I guess the price works for some people.
the heroes have been balanced pretty well as well as new evolutions hero progression issues have been fixed

A game that keeps on giving. I've played this for years. I rate 4 stars, as I do think the game was better at first. Most updates and new cards seem to have changed the game to worse. Also every time a new card is made, it is over powered. I suppose this makes everyone want to own the card and spend money to level it up. Then after a year or so it is nerfed to balance. I love the game anyway!

This went from good to very bad. I would not recommend putting money into it if you actually want an edge in the game. It almost seems fun until you play for a few weeks. Its very unbalanced and you will see the same cards being used by everyone and if you don't have them, you're screwed. Had to uninstall to make space to make my phone run just that much faster and I still get adds for it. No! Never again!

I played this game when it first came out years ago and I recently picked it back up. I can't, I just can't. It's 100% pay-to-win, does very unbalanced opponent matching, and is full of noticable cheater/hacker. Not to mention, in the past 5 years, they have hardly added new content and what little content they have added is just completely unbalanced with the rest of the game. Would NOT recommend this game unless you want to spend money for a bunch of nonsense to make yourself better. 🚫

When clash Royale came out, it was a fun and unique game. You choose very carefully what you would upgrade and what strategy to play. It was very balanced and when you lost it felt like you legitimately got outplayed. All of that is gone. The game has genuinely become pay to win. They will add new content that takes several months to unlock while playing free. And by the time you finally unlock it, it will be nerfed. This game is not fun anymore, do not download it. It will only waste your time.

Game is very unbalanced. You can pay to get gold and cards to level up quickly. Otherwise the game is extremely grindy. It will take you well over a year and a half to get to max level. On top of that, those who pay can upgrade their cards faster, giving an unfair advantage on the field. The challenges are barely worth trying since they're dominated by players with very high level cards and towers. An OKAY game at best.

It was all good about a year ago, but now every time i open clash royale , first match will be delayed upto 1 minute and i will be lost. It takes a lot of time to open every day's first match. I got my new bluetooth headphones and when i connect it, it is strucking with audio and more disturbances are coming. It is normal when i play without headphones. I thought it is headphones fault and i tried to listen songs on youtube without disconnecting them, it was excellent and same repeats again...

It's becoming more and more of a pay to win game. There's quite little you can do to progress, especially at the higher leagues, but then there are players who buy a royal pass and bam! They'd progress with the speed of light. There is an exponential difference in opportunities between those who pay and those who don't. It is now frustratingly difficult to keep on playing without paying. The only reason I gave it 2 instead of 1 star is that i' ve been playing this game from before it was p2w.

Fun game to play, not too many updates but when there are it's just new characters and such. Not much maintenance patches. No lag, not really, gameplay is simple. Update since 05/2018 The new boat clan war is lame the first day it came out. Lots of people already knew it would kill the game, and it has. Besides that, game is the same. Matchmaking is off sometimes. I'm maxed out and play against lvl 10s in war or so. Makes no sense. No interest in this game anymore

Match ups can be a little one sided. But a good simple to play game. ^^^ Initial review^^^ Since then ... Frustrated with constant "Balancing" of cards by the manufacturers ... The way I see it ... you focus on building the strengths of the cards you like to use based on a certain deck strategy ... then all of a sudden ... a card you have worked to build up gets a review (Witch😢) ... and no longer has the impact or works in with your strategy ... now trying to find a new strategy ...

Clash Royale does a great job of staying engaging at all levels of play with its MMR system. It's a good strategy card game and has a reasonable way to reach end game content without getting boring. My main problem with the game is an extremely weak clan system. Recruitment is basically impossible without being extremely high level or lucky. The clan system is really only useful for requesting and chatting with friends. It could practically be an auction house and be the same in usability.

Not gonna lie this is an amazing game. If you play it too long it may die out, like on me. But have to admit they have changed so much to the game but kept the core mechanics the same. Only thing is you need time to play the game or atleast pay to continue in some scenarios. Great game. Definitely recommend strategic players to try it out for yourself!!!

This game has one of the worst matchmaking system among other games. For real; I'm level 11 with my level 11 & 10 cards while my opponent is level 11 with their level 12, 13, & 14 cards. How am I supposed to defeat them? Although you could say it's a strategy game, but that's not the point. It's also an RPG game which has a level system. Whatever I do, my lvl 11 cards would never beat their lvl 13 cards. Sometimes I also face a level 10 player with their lower lvl cards, I feel bad for them too.

Honestly a very fun game, not too addictive and just as fun for casual gameplay as well as serious gameplay. Very simple to get the hang of and overall just a great game, i would probably rate the game itself 4-5 stars. However their suppory system is appalling. I have been trying for ages to find fixes for issues but seem unable to. The only 'help and support' they offer is a list of 50-100 questions, and if your question isn't on there, you're gonna have to solve it yourself. No live chats.

I used to have fun with this game years ago. Now it became a game for people who pay to have more upgrades and more advantages. So new people get screwed. It's very hard to win a game in Clash Royale now. I tried several decks that used to work before but it doesn't matter because my towers and cards are lower level compared to other players. I always lose. They should balance the game allowing only players of the same level against each other. It's simply Unplayable!

Played it very actively for over a year but then quit 4 years ago. I downloaded it again to check it out for a day, and was sad to note that the same issues plague this otherwise great game. There are a lot of new cards, but the common/rare ones are complete garbage. The best decks in the game still include 3+ specific legendaries, which are really hard to get if you're free to play. At least you get two or three guaranteed legendaries as you level up now but there's like 15 of them by now...

Have been playing for more than 3 years, and this has been the final straw. Laggy servers, unexplained prices, and awfully pay 2 win. Prepared to get nothing but misery and years of getting tilted with them not giving anything for you. It has been one of the very best games I have played, but now has become the very worst I have seen. This had been a great journey, but as the hero lived long enough to become the villain, this game has become too much of a pain to play.

I used to have fun playing this game until they nerfed the pass royale progression and now gives 1/3 of what it used to. On top of that, they tripled the cost of the pass. They added a new level, which adds nothing to the game, and this time, it is very costly and nearly impossible to max a deck. Costing 100 champions for a single level 15 card and books only work towards 1/10 of a level 15 upgrade. They've ruined the game and given an unfair advantage to spenders. This game is dying. Delete

If you like to play games without spending money then play this, and lose every single game you play. Clash Royale is the biggest pay to win game on the app store. Sure it's a fun game in the lower levels but theres a point when you start playing people with 2 levels higher than you and their cards are way better, not to mention their extra health on the tower's. I could recommend this game to people that have lots of money to spend and people who are absolutely never mad or frustrated.

Never able to get into the game after the Sep 30th update. It's either "Login Failed" or " Connection Error", or I think there is another error msg about the server or something. Tried uninstall-restart-reinstall for dozens of times but obviously didn't work. The help desk did not offer any helpful advice either. I shouldn't have complained about the frequent crashes earlier, cause at I could at least log in then. I liked the game a lot, but disappointed now. Hope the team could fix this soon.

So annoying, i can't play it anymore. It used to be so much fun, but right now you enjoy it only if you spend money on a monthly base to buy things. Whenever i click that battle button i always get opponents 11 or 12 tower level with troops level 14. Like why is even possible? You get destroyed in a sec. Sure for a company the more profit the better, but there should be a balance because its becoming tiring for a big number of players.

Pay to win. Used to be a fun strategy game, but over the years, they've made it much harder to have an enjoyable experience without paying ridiculous amounts of money. It still has its moments, but they are overshadowed by seemingly unwinnable games and constant toxic behavior from other players. Also, the app frequently restarts in the middle of games, ruining the few games that are fairly matched. This was my go-to time killer for a long time, but it looks like it's time to find something new

Game is so bad I can't even Install it. Just goes to 90% and stops. I've had the game on other devices before, same issue occurred. The one time I actually was able to download and play the game I had a terrible experience. Horrible skill based match making, impossible to play unless you use the broken cards, and extremely laggy. I would spawn into a fight with my king tower at half health points.

I would've given this 5 stars if this issue didn't keep happening to me. The game crashes unexpectedly but often when I'm opening chests... Which is to me one of the most rewarding experiences of the game. I'm afraid to buy any chests now as I'm quite sure that my money will be wasted. I just tried to open a big chest and was so excited and I got two cards out of it before it crashed. I'm so upset! I really wish the company would fix that issue, I am so frustrated that I want to give up the game entireIy.

Used to be great. Everytime you start to catch up they shift everything so you have to buy a ton. It's a cash grab. Game is fun, but infuriating when you put so much time to max out each card, then they raise the max...also, when u finally do remax them, you'll still get the cards in chests, so they don't even help you. I'm gonna uninstall if it keeps this up. I wouldn't get invested in it. Too frustrating to have to pay to win. If all else is equal, fun strategy game. But it's not equal.

Imagine an uno player try this game, and well that player is me. The game is a great time passer game the matches mostly take about 1-3 mins of gameplay. I just wish that they added a feature where I can save my gameplays to my device saying that I'm a content creator of many games already and I wanted to edit it. But still, its a great game until you reach a point where you'll feel stuck, keep pushing and you'll reach to the last arena. Goodluck on playing and I hope you reach your goal.

The game is in a heavy downward spiral with how the game is being handled. It is becoming such an issue that content creator and pro players are losing favor in the game. I feel nothing but anger when I'm playing. I installed and reinstalled the game 5 times, I believe. It's final this time since there is no point in someone picking up the game again or for the first time unless they are certain they want to spend money. There is no optional part anymore if you want to actually progress.

Save your money. The game is very unfair. It makes you play with higher level players all the time. I think it is all about money. The more you pay the easier matches you get. Level 8 players against level 10 and 11 players mathematically very difficult. Not fun for new players who are just growing. Clan wars require you to have 4 decks of 8 troops, which is 32. It won't be easy to level them all up easily and you will face a lot of unfair matches and unnecessary stress in your life.

Still playing it hoping the bot issue will be corrected . Seems the game will let u win 3 in a row, then take u down , over and over till u drop 1 or 2 arenas, This game would be great, if not for the 3rd party interference from bots, it allows them to cream u in minutes , they can toss out tons of high level troops that u cannot do, we an only work with 10 elixer drops at a time . So very frustrating, and if not fixed soon the game is gone, been playing from day 1, and the fun is getting ruined

Games fun and all. Ok, progression system, different decks are all fun to use and whatnot, and visuals are really good for such a simple game. Only gripe, really, like everyone else has already said, is the "pay to win" aspect. Playing players with max cards in lower arenas isn't fun at all, and almost garuntees a loss. Fun game, though, if it weren't so geared towards pay to win gameplay. Bummer...

This isn't a strategy game. online battles devolve into who's played the game longer, and who got the legendary cards. Half of the time I would lose battles because my opponent would spawn absurd amounts of high value units far faster than I could. It seemed like the bar that fills to let you place units was just slower for me, because it would take me several seconds to spawn something, and it seemed like my opponent could spawn two per second for the sane thing.

The game WAS fun. But that was before they decided to go more heavily into in-app purchases and making it a pay-to-win game. It used to be pretty competitive but now if you buy anything to give you a leg up, you can't be beaten. The same goes for opponents. Unless you pay for the 2000+ gem chests (which translates to roughly $100 in real currency) then you'll get the same 5 cards over and over and over again. The game offers no room to grow.

I have been playing this game for 6 years. Since the early and good days of it. The game was fun, challenging, and most importantly fair. However, through the recent years, it's like the game devs ate shifting more toward "pay to win", and it was at this point which marked the beginning of a downfall of the game. Imagine you have been playing the game for years, with so much experience and decent amount of resources, just to be beaten by someone who bought their way and maxed out everything.

Once I heard, good things always ends. I must say it is true. This game changes a lot of things, not in a good way. First they added more levels and champions, now they added much more money-hungry features such as evolution cards and diamond battle pass. They also removed books of books from the battle pass which is one of the valuest thing to buy from it. I feel like I can't continue playing this game any longer to save my money and sanity.

There's not enough room here to explain what is wrong with this game. Within the last month or so it tries to wipe my progress regularly. Out of nowhere I'm in training mode. I am able to recover my progress, but it'll happen 5 minutes after a last login. But I've been helping my young son to build himself a game. He's worked very hard, gotten to level 5, and was really proud. Supercell wiped his game today. I have no idea if I can get it back. I'm livid. Garbage company and game.

The latest update has made it so that the chest timer resets randomly when closing the game when it is a queued chest. I got the league pass to help with the game but instead has been a detriment. After reaching out to support they said its a known issue and they are working on it but was nothing they could do. Waiting almost 2 days for a chest is a big issue. I probably won't get the league pass again.

I played this for years, spent a lot of money and loved it, then for whatever reason they got rid of the best way to play, non trophy game modes were insanely fun, 2x elixir, 3x elixir, and everything in between, made it so much more fun then the standard mode and was optional for anyone who didn't want to play it. Gone. And so am I. Unistalled

unfortunately there's more and more cheats in the game, the match making has become ridiculous playing against people who are tiers above with maxed decks and sometimes seemingly with extra cards, supercell don't seem to care as long as people spend lots of money. Sadly the game is becoming unpleasantly unplayable

Unfairness, in its worst shape. I don't mind paying. Even just donating to the developers. And this game is so fun & requires thinking and strategy. So, it could be one of the best games of all times. BUT, there is a huuuuge disadvantage to people who don't spend any money. I have been playing for 3yrs & I'm level 10. 80% of the times at score 4700 I am matched w a lvl 12 with troops at 13. Do the math and they are 50% stronger than me w castles. That's horrible!!! DON'T WASTE YOUR TIME!

I've been playing this game for 7 years now and the latest changes to the game are just greedy. They have increased the cost of the premium by 25% and decreased the bonuses you get for it, and then to add insult, they now have en even more expensive tier for double what it used to cost, only to get what you used to get for half the price. You are selling virtual items with zero expense. You are officially ripping off your customers. I will never give Supercell money again. This is too far.

I've been playing this game for fer years, it was a great game, very well balanced and I had a lot of fun playing. Up to now, with all the new paid buffs, it is simply impossible to play without paying, in freemium game model to destroy the balance in such a way is suicide! Good luck with keeping you player audience with a 5% win rate for non paying player. It really sucks you destroyed the game. Goodbye.

It was good when it launched. Now its just pay to win. I am always matched against a higher level player once i cross a certain threshold in trophies so basically I'm stuck at one place. I have to wait like this for long time or i can buy ton of gems and level up my cards fast. The developers getting greedy day by day. They are more focused on cosmetics and less on mechanics & matchmaking, so this is a pay to win basically.

Out of every game in the world, this is the biggest example of wasted potential. The core mechanics of the game are brilliant, however the game is completely unplayable without either years of grinding OR as supercell wants, no exaggeration, hundreds of dollars. Every update compounds this problem, and the developers clearly have no interest in improving the game, only in making more money. A true shame, as the gameplay itself would have made it the perfect mobile game if it was only fair.

Has such potential but its pay to win. constantly get paired against players who spend money to have the most over powered card and win the game within the first 30 seconds. There shouldn't even be an option to do that. Not to mention the game is just a desperate money grab. There's a "path" that gives you "Free" loot, but first you need to pay $3 for item 1, then you can get item 2 but oh wait, gotta pay $3 for item 3, and then 5 and then 7 and so on. All just so you get gear you shouldn't have

Played for years, spent some $, and I expect to pay for good entertainment. However, now you have to spend money regularly, just to keep up. Beyond that, it's hard to figure what the point is. I think the game has stalled, and creator direction is haphazard at best. Seems like constant tweaks to keep money rolling in for no real improvement in experience. Play BB as well, and same story... tired of supercell.

Great game, occasionally you'll come across people who pay to play but you dont have to spend money to enjoy 2021: I have been playing this game off/on for the last 4 years and sadly it has become saturated with loot boxes & pay to play mechanisms. The last 4 years is proof that there is an algorithm which prevents you from collecting and maxing the cards you most use, without spending money. It's akin to gambling, it really sucks that a lot of kids play this and are used to pay to win games.

It was really enjoyable until it wasn't. I'm all for giving a company money, especially when the product is free. But Supercell has littered both coc/cr with micro transactions ranging from the prices of full AAA game titles. In the past, I thought the grind was fun, and paying for gems was a helpful boost. Now, they just can't help themselves and stunt all progress for players who are having too fun and not paying (enough).

The advertisement on YouTube shows the person who is losing using the 'angry character' and him saying 'Hold Hold' but when you play, it is some one who is ranked higher than you (or a lower rank that spent money and every character is ranked 14 or higher) talking trash. You could be better but it really doesn't matter. Frustrating game, making them millions though, keep spending!

Ca$h Royale used to be my favorite game, but recent changes have ruined it. I played since launch and bought many of the $5 passes. I tried playing for the first time in months a few days ago with mortar and lost to someone playing hog, eq, and lvl 15 evo firecracker. The only way for me to gain trophies would be to spend even more money, which seems to be what the devs want. Goodbye cr, youll be remembered, but not missed.

Played this game on and off for years. Makes the game difficult when some players use "cheats". Have played against some where the creatures made are impossible to make as quickly as they have. And when watching the battle back, the opponents elixir bar fills suspiciously fast. No way you can make a mega knight, pecka, with support before they cross to your side of the field.

I have been playing this game for many years (at least since 2018/2019, if not earlier. I used to LOVE this game, I made friends and family download it so we could play together, and it was a blast! I had great times and really enjoyed farming my way up. Since the introduction of the "double battle pass" and evolutions, I think they've been pushing a bit too much into the hard currency rewards/pay to advance mechanics, but what I personally find worse of all is the endless scrolling in the UI

I love that Clash Royal is finding ways to create longevity in the game. In my last review, that was the change I wanted to see and gold being easier to get. I feel that was accomplished but at a huge cost to the free to play community where even the pass, which I use to buy, is not worth it to be buying monthly. I love that there is more to do but now progression is hard and not as enjoyable with all the additional features stunting F2P in relevance in the game.

Just another pay2win game You can play normally at certain point with basic cards, but after a time, you'll get opponents with higher level towers and cards than yours, that its almost impossible to win, not only the matchmaking gets horrible, the chances to get good card are extremely rare, and once you get you're stuck in the same level for a long time, if you want to have fun for a time and delete go for it, but if not you'll be forced to spend money to keep going up.

Great game, fun and somehow strategic. However, the "pay to win" royale pass is unfair for players who did not purchase the pass. One might play for a year and work their way to a level 12, while a player with the pass could reach higher levels in 6 months. The best solution is to match players according to their status, that is, if they have paid for credits or not.

I've always enjoyed this game when the game first came out. The game was fun and you needed skill and patience to gain wins. Now it's practically RNG with higher card levels and the algorithm match making. If you're looking to have fun, this is not the game to choose. Most of the player base is competitive sweats, trust me, I'm one of them. It's very frustrating to play as you can't have fun making your own decks anymore. It's all just "meta" no individuality. Supercell has been trying too hard.

Definitely my most played mobile game. 2025 Update: I took a long break from the game and reinstalled to see the new content... and man it's bad. They somehow found a way to make the game even more pay to win with the unfair evolutions, which are just better, overpowered versions of troops that are extremely difficult to get without paying for them. Was fun to try out the new troops they added then I uninstalled after seeing evo firecracker for the 100th time in a row. Not worth it.

Been playing with my clan since 2016. We've all lost interest over the past 6 months. We're maxed out with nowhere to go. The season pass isn't exciting by any means and its laughable for $5. They need something big. More levels, cards, arenas, modes, CUSTOMIZATION... even the Clan Wars 2 update is blah. Battle ship defenses for minimal rewards of the saaaaame stuff.

It was fun for a little while, and then the strategy became nothing but stall on the original version. I was gone for a bit, and when I came back, they had party mode. That's where you could earn chests while playing interesting games like 3x elixir, but with the update today, they took that away. Uninstalled just now and not looking back, party mode was the last fun bit keeping me holding on and buying the season pass.

In the usual CR fashion, the new update is riddled with source code and algorithm issues. Mostly in the 2V2 mode but it can be seen across the entire platform. Once again we see the uneven game matching as well as the return of the super elixirs. Good luck non pay to play gamers. If you're in it for the long haul, it will certainly be a tough ride. Our suggestion is to find another game to play until the super brains at supercell fix it.

I would just like to say that this game was really fun for the first 5000 trophies, but afterwards, it became a pay 2 win unbeatable mess. I'll go up 100 trophies and drop due to overleveled cards, cards that shouldn't be obtainable in the current arena, and the constant reminder of such being shown in the store with 8 offers showing up before you get to free items which by the way aren't even that great. Supercell, you are a money hungry company that couldn't care less about their playerbase.

Great game if you enjoy paying to win. Great opportunities to have fun, but you are limited due to the restraints of the game wanting you to spend money on chests, chest unlocks, Pass Royale, emotes, etc. Also, with Pass Royale being introduced, players who purchase it get bonuses that give them an edge over other players. That would be fine if the game were not considered "Free to Play"; however, it is not.

Gameplay is pretty solid, all things considered. However, many units are simply poor and shouldn't be in the game anyway. The evolution mechanic is trash, and again, shouldn't be in the game. What inspired me to leave a poor review most, however, is the Shop, which has become a pit of mud. I counted today: 16 different $ offers before I could see the free shop. They keep making things worse for F2P. For example, they thought it would be a good idea to lower free content in the pass royale. Trash

very average and honestly not too fun, but can sometimes be enjoyable. this is because of the fact that you just fight others, have to wait hours to progress through the game and upgrade things, and decks can be easily overpowered and can take down anyone, which is unfair, and not fun. Sometimes it is fun and fair, but it isn't that often, which also makes it not fun. it's ok I guess.

Great mechanics and we'll thought out, I love the animation and the wide variety of characters. Although these are good it is heavily dependent on the money you spend for more cards, but this can not compare to the community. Ever since day one I have been spammed by taunts everyone I lose. The game play it's self can get repetitive after awhile as well.

This game has so much potential. It immediately presents itself as a fair 1v1 deck building game where you outskill your opponent and strategize to become victorious, but it becomes obvious fairly quickly that any amount of skill can be easily replaced with a few dollars from your credit card. The game is filled to the brim with loot boxes and the rarest cards that could come out of those boxes or the "legendary" cards are incredibly overpowered. Tl;dr: pay to win, not worth your time.

Last week I got my 4 year badge, I've been enjoying this game for that long. Since the latest update, I lost all enjoyment in this game. Now if you don't mind spending 6 or 12 dollars a month, this game is for you. For free-to-play players like myself, will have to play catch up every year they add a new card level. Card leveling is not fun, and with the new update; progression has been slower. Core game play is still fun, but not if you're stuck with your one or two fully leveled up deck.

Used to be fun and met a lot of great people on the game. With the nerf of the pass, paying players get less bang for their buck and f2p players get even less. A whole ~12 us dollars for rewards that don't do too much(also considering that the rewards included so much previously for only $5!). Additionally, with level 15 coming sometime in the future, clash isn't looking to good. And I thought level 14 would be the last of it... The final straw has been pulled.

For the love of God please lower the cool down for clan wars! It's better than it was, slightly. But the cool down time is just ridiculous. I feel like you should be able to get two rounds of attacks in per day. In theory clan wars is awesome but in practice it's really just annoying and I feel forced into it. I run a clan and unfortunately due to the lack of ability to opt in/out of war I've had to kick so many people. There should be an option to partake in war like in COC. Please change!

So this is how the algorithm works now - you win 2-3 games at a stretch and then start loosing. After loosing some matches you win one or two and again start loosing. In the sometimes they'll give you a huge trophy push, and then bring you down so that you are hooked to gaining back the lost trophies. This makes the game addictive in a frustration way. I used to play this before, then stopped, again started. But from now I'll never play this anymore. Also it's so pay to win now.

it was fun!!! but once they made the game more about spending money it become so annoying. this game is made in such way that u will not enjoy it if you don't spent money. 4 years ago it was the best mobile game and now it just feels like they don't care much about fairness. I was tower level 12 with all my troops are either level 12 or 13. I faced player that had tower level 11 but units that were maxed out. it shouldn't be that way. if u want to download it make sure you have money to spent.

I have been seeing many people say this is pay to win. That is not entirely fair. I have been playing for 5 years... I have leveled up my cards over that time, so have thousands of others. That being said, yes, you can pay to level cards more quickly. And they often nurf cards that don't need it, and kill cards completely by over compensating... I don't like it as much as I used to but it is still fun for a match our two every day

The unlock times are so freaking long. Don't get me wrong, the gameplay is very good, but damn it puts a damper on things. Yeah, you can play even if the chest queue is full but dn, it feels so unrewarding if you do since you don't get anything... I understand that you need to timegate stuff supercell, but the way you went about it is... Pretty poorly thought of to say it nicely.

Last patch completely wrecked this game. Everything that may be of interest is now locked behind pay walls. As a veteran player, the only thing I had to look forward to was the possibility of new backgrounds. Use to be able to farm gems in hopes of getting the ones i wanted. Now that is next to impossible. The ones you CAN get get by doing dailies are not so great and bland. Overall, I only log in occasionally to kill time. I use to pay the $5.99 pass but now rewards from that are lacking.

I have been playing this game for the last 8 years and now this has become the worst game I have ever played. Every time I got disconnected during battle and because of this I lost 2000+ trophies. I need compensation.

Like the game and they have finally strick a balance between pay and non-pay to win players. The game is not perfect, but it is quite good. The monthly balance does get annoying at times, as they take cards with high win rates and "nerf" them. Typically new cards come in overpowered and there's a race to use them and purchase opportunities to get them only to have the card depowered within the next couple of updates.

I've been playing this game for about a year as a Free to Play and I have made it to nearly legendary arena. The game is super fun and I have spent countless hours playing. The UI is fun and colorful and there are a lot of different characters and possible decks. My only complaint is how much they annoy you to pay for rewards and perks, even though most people can level up and progress just fine without season pass, paid cards, etc.

It's a pay to win game, don't recommend it. It may seem that you can upgrade without spending real money, but the algorythms of the game are way more clever than you think you are. So it will force you to spend real money, to achieve what other p2w players has achieved. It will only give you opponents that are higher level than you. It's not strategy, it's unbalance and p2w game. It's not a hate, I've been playing this game for more than two years, and I only have two cards upgraded at max lvl))

Matchmaking is still bad after you go on a win streak. Also I think you guys should add names on who are online. Maybe put like a green dot next to their name when they're online and nothing when offline UPDATE: 5 years after and matchmaking is still awful. You go on a win streak and the algorithm then makes you lose a lot to keep it "even". There is absolutely no reason for me to be lvl. 10 facing a lvl. 12.

I've played hundreds of hours of clash royale, and I can tell you that this game used to be amazing. However, Supercell cannot delivering the experience that they used to. Now, matchmaking is a horrific experience, there's a battle pass, and the game feels MUCH more pay to win then it used to. I'd love to give it a good review for the years of enjoyment it gave me, but I cannot. Supercell has lost the way. I dont recommend this game to anyone.

I played the game for almost 2 years. Even spent some money, which is rare for me. But these last two updates back to back have really shown that supercell is no longer concerned with keeping things fair or a lesser version of pay2win. If you like spending money to have a significant advantage, this game is for you. It'll be a fun game until you reach the higher end of the game. Then be prepared to break out your wallet to get ahead in any way. Game is a joke now.

Updated: Avoid at all costs, company has given up trying to make a fun game anyone can enjoy and has resorted to catering to only whales. I've played this game for many years now and always held on hope that things would get better, I've given up. I don't believe they will turn things around or care anymore. Those in charge seem to be focused on draining as much money from their dying game as possible while they still can. Don't waste your time!

You should be able to change your name as many times. But either than that it is a good game. I change my mind. I have been playing this gane since the dawn of time and the state it's currently in is just sad. They chase nothing but profit by forcing you to play against people who are in higher levels than you so that you are enticed to buy in-game purchases. The season resets are also a way to make you pair with higher level players. Game is not fun and I would not reccomend downloading it!!!!

I deleted this game a couple of years ago due to the moronic decision of the developer to add taunting as a requirement of playing the game. Fast forward a couple of years and a mute option has been added for the taunting. The game is now being deleted for a different reason. I bought one of the special offers yesterday, and was double charged. When I reported that I was double charged Supercell wiped out some of my deck that I had before the offer to correct their error. As always, Supercell's concern is about profit, not doing right by the customer. So I am no longer their customer.

Absolutely scam. Biggest money making game I've ever played. Not about the experience of the players.. Bring out updates and make the game harder, trying to make people who play it spend more. Probably bots too. Also bring out an update where the maximum characters have to get further levelled up. Sick of it. Also, not to mention you can't buy what you want; everything is wild-carded making it an EVEN more of a money making scheme. Go away

The game in general is fun and was almost perfect. However with the release of wild cards (an item that lets you level up a card of the same rarity), the game has become pay to win. You cannot avoid this since you are put against people with the same trophy level. This means that you'll lose matches regardless if you have skill or not. This game is supposed to be about strategy, but at this point it's more about who's willing to pay more money in leveling up their card deck.

The game is fun, but the matchmaking system is a joke, as almost every match I'll fight someone several levels below me which makes those wins feel cheap. (At the time of writing this, I'm level 11 in legendary arena). The progression is also a grind as cards cost exponentially more gold as you go along while the rewards don't scale enough. It's not worth buying gems in this game as the normal chests are overpriced for what they give. (20$ for a guaranteed legendary) It's a somewhat fun grind.

Game is fixed, don't be the first person to put a card down. Which means make sure you have a few good defensive cards. If you don't place the right card at the right time you're game is basically over. Which is difficult given the obvious lag that the developers have never fixed. Some cards say they do certain things, then they don't. Don't buy anything here, basic time waster of a game.

The game is addicting. It's a fun tactical game. However, the matchmaking can be very bad. Guy 2 levels higher than me on my arena crushes me. Also, hackers can be found. Not fun when 3 pekka appear early on, and I'm elixir counting. It's fun but frustrating, which is why I gave it a lower score. Game is also extremely, and I mean EXTREMELY unbalanced. They're almost as bad as Riot games in respects balancing

One word can be used to describe this game, pay 2 win. Game starts of enjoyable than you reach a point where every match you go against cards 4 levels higher than yours, this makes it almost impossible to win unless your opponent is completely incapable. Progression is very slow, the only way to progress faster is by paying. So I would not recommend this game, every once in a while you get a glimpse of hope to keep you going. But you are destined to fail without a credit card.

This game has been deteriorating for a few years now, but the latest upgrade has decimated the game. The structure of the game has been made 'brainless'. Up until recently you had a few options to build cards in a minor way via the 'shop'. Now there is no way to play things you're own way. After playing this game for 9 years, this latest update has destroyed the game. I think Supercell realizes the game is fading and they are out to get the last of the Pay to win players before it folds.

Clash Royale could've been one of the best mobile games. The gameplay is fun, fast-paced, and strategic. But it's heavily pay-to-win, ruining the experience for casual or fair players. Early on, progress feels good—you unlock cards and improve. But soon, you face players with over-leveled decks unless you pay a lot. It's frustrating and unfair. Not recommended if you're free-to-play. And bring back the season shop for us the free-to-play

I used to pay $5 monthly for a pass which was reasonable for the amount of entertainment I got out of the game. Even though I was paying, I still thought the game allowed free to play players a reasonable chance to compete. However, the new update definitely makes it a pay to win game AND with more than doubling the price while giving less for it? I won't be paying and soon probably won't be competitive, which probably means not playing (or paying!) much longer...

0/5 stars. Ever since you moved the 2v2 modes, no one plays them anymore. Can't find any games because it takes 10 minutes to find them. ALSO I exclusively played the party modes ever since it was a main attraction to the game, which you recent hid in the menu. I specifically paid to upgrade my cards for these modes, I've maxed out at least 4 of cards. Now there is a cap to them. So ALLLLLL the money I spent is wasted. I will be submitting a refund claim to Google Play.

Pay to win. Rigged arcade-like game reminiscent of old coin-op machines where you were destined to lose no matter how well you played. Which is fine (because the developer can do whatever they want to make money.) The truly sad part is that people think that half the time they are playing other people!! That is a misrepresentation by the company. Half the time you are simply playing the comp. Ends up just being frustrating and no fun. Find another game to waste time in and don't stress about CR.

Originally a really fun game. It deserved the 5 stars I gave it in 2016. Now in 2024. This game could disappear off the app store I wouldn't care. Prices of micro transactions is crazy high for what they are. Cards are really unbalanced. I single card could destroy my whole deck. It's kinda ridiculous. "Oh the game is teaching you how to play" no the game is teaching me to spend money if I want cool stuff. Good luck supercell, you've become a joke of a company in my opinion

Fallen from grace. This still is one of the best mobile real-time-strategy games but I just cannot recommend it after all the predatory changes to the monetization system. You will like it at first but eventually the gameplay becomes unfun as you must bang your head against the wall that is max level decks which you will never be able to obtain.

Disappointed that there aren't any safe guards to prevent accidental emote purchases. There should be a second pop-up that asks if you're sure you would like to purchase this emote so you can click yes purchase, or no do not. Instead they basically tell you "too bad so sad, we can't reverse it because it would be unfair and others would take advantage of that feature". They expect you to spend more money on gems in order to immediately replace what you accidentally spent, so more $ for them.

I am furious. I bought a gold pack with money that you guys have claimed that I requested a refund for. Whereas in my Google account I have 0 refund requests or transactions and the money is missing from my bank account. Customer service basically told me "There's nothing we can do, but you can buy more gold!" Don't make purchases on this game cause if something goes wrong, they WILL NOT HELP YOU.

I played the game for a long time through many updates and I can say without a doubt that it is terrible. It's pay-to-win posing as a free game and the amount of money the game makes is ridiculous considering how lazy it is. Unbalanced to the point of having an undeniable meta, bad players drop ranks so they can win battles and even with a good connection it will lag so bad that you will miss entire battles. Essentially the game is saying "Pay for me so you can play the way I want you to play.".

Been playing for more than 3years. They make it easy for you to play at the start, but makes it almost Impossible to win unless you pay for upgrades later on. In the end, strategy doesn't matter since you will be matched with level13/14 paying players who haven't even played a long time. At least in PUBG upgrades are cosmetic and doesn't affect your game performance. This game is all about making money. Don't waste your time. Oh this causes Screen Burn in over time.

The game itself is fun, but if you haven't been playing for years or aren't willing to pay up, you're not going to make much progress. Lowered from 4 to 3 stars due to the 2nd evolution slot being locked behind king level 15. I accept Supercell wants to make money, but it's gotten to the point where they're just sabotaging their own game to try and squeeze more cash out of players.

It's definitely the worst game of Supercell nowadays. Each update they are monetizing everything in the game. Battle pass, Golden Bank and, especially, the "best" offers in the shop. Balance of the game became pay to win battles where you will be stuck for a long time before you upgrade to a level on which you will be able to make some progress on your path. I was playing this game from the release of it, feeling bad about these changes to my favorite game then.

Theres no balance in this game whatsoever. Higher level players can ruin the experience of lower level players pretty much at will. Pay to win or get screwed over that's the SuperCell way I guess. You would think they would put you up against players with similar skill level, but no. It puts you against pros on an ult constantly. It's all about thier precious esport. I've been playing for more than a year with little to no reward for being dedicated to the game. They care about money and that's all. Dont download it, it's a waste of time and money.

I have spent untold thousands of hours on this game. The core gameplay is the best game ever made. However, the last few updates have been shifting the game towards more and monetization. Games need to make money, but it shouldn't lock away gameplay. There is so much potential for more cosmetics. Charge through the roof for skins, for customising your side of the arena etc. I would pay so much to get a limited edition brand deal starwars lightsaber for a mini pekka, or whatever. Not level 15!

They ruined the game. Unless you want to spend $50 on cards and evolutions, you will not progress. You used to be able to make progress as a f2p player, even though it was very p2w. Now it's nearly pay to play. edit: Tried the game again. It's even worse. Now there are champions that are incredibly overpowered. some of which are locked behind a pay wall. They also added ANOTHER level to grind for at the exact same time. If you are starting out free to play... good luck, you will need it.

Great app, but still waiting for ability to queue all chests, not just 1 after the current unlocking chest. Sometimes people do not log on because they can't, and chests are left unlocked for a day or so. And the feature is nice, but why not include up to all 4 chests?? instead of just one. 4 stars until that change is made. Thanks! Maybe make the 1 queued chest free, and all 4 part of buying the pass. Also, it feels like they got lazy with note ratio. Bottom buttons are ugly stretched...

So I already had a review on this game in which I ranted about how the Royale Pass made the game too pay to win. However, there have been recent updates allowing free to play players to progress easier, and it is much appreciated. Unfortunatley, there are still cases in where you get matched up against players that have much better things than you, making the game unbalanced, so alot of balance changes have yet to be made. Words cannot describe how much I hate this game. After trying (and failing) to get to the legendary arena they add in two more arenas within the same hour I finally get there. You cannot get ahead in the game unless you pay for chests or their "totally not pay to win" magical items that can instantly level up any card and upgrade it for free... for the low low price of five dollars. On top of that the game will decide that you have won too much and match youup against someone whois leagues ahed

Working as a software tester led me to realise that no program could ever be perfect. However, there are some glaring issues to this game, especially with the new update. 1. The push back on how rewards are obtained in favor of some money is a kill-joy in my opinion, especially with no more in-game currency shop. Shadow what the game was tbh

This game used to be very fun, but I simply can not recommend it to anyone anymore. I even invested a few bucks, like 15 bucks on the passes a few seasons when the game was fun, but it's not anymore. It has been progressing more and more P2W, unlike other Supercell games. Don't bother starting now.

You might want to try and do a little work on the matchmaking algorithm that you use. You have these challenges to unlock new cards or cards that are harder to come by and somehow I am paired up against people with exponentially better cards - who (in reference to the rage challenge) already had the dang card. I am currently in Arena 10 and only have 3 legendary cards. I refuse to spend money on the game because I am quickly realizing that it is a pay to play game. I have been playing this game for a while now, this is my second account - got a new phone and lost the other account. I just wish you could either try and make the matchups a little closer or at least make it to where you can win without having to spend money, but then again that probably isn't something y'all want to do...oh well that's just my two cents

I used to play on a different device and loved it! When I switched to android 9 years ago I had to start over. I recently redownloaded it, but im stuck replaying the last training match over and over. kinda unplayable, and needs to be addressed, especially if this is b anything that someone else has dealt with too

The recent addition of lvl 15,removal of gems from masterys and the changing of the pass of only made the game worse. and while the new evos are cool, they are greatly overshadowed by what has been taken from the average player. They made progression harder, more tedious, and less fun. The difference between free to play and paying players has never been more apparent.

This game has some serious balancing issues in matchmaking, I thought the game was supposed to be fair for everyone that played? Not just those who have high levels, I was playing against players that were level 9 when I was only a level 6. Dont waste your time. it was cool when you first start. but they really push spending your money. When I started playing it was a perfect, simple game, now it's way overcomplicated and completely pay to win, it has left me no choice but to either pay or uninstall. over years playing this game, it was fun at first, but with the recent update, it got boring, and it got a lot harder to get cards now, and really, with the mistake update. I used to love this game, it was one of my absolute favorites when it came out, and it had some bad updates in the past, but they always bounced back. This game has been on a steady decline for years. To same the game hasn't always been p2w would be dishonest.
