I have been in here for a long while and I have spent some money as well. The game presentation is a hoax, along with the game itself. There exists no balance whatsoever, as supercell would have you believe, there are not even basic restrictions and rules, in order to make sure that the game is having a basic concept, it is an anarchic mumble jumble, sold as something else.

I hope to god they decide to actually balance out all the cards. Combine this with level differences because its a free-to-play game where you can buy stuff with real money, and it makes this game one of the most unfair, infuriatingly difficult to master games on the app store. Clash Royale is an embaressment to games with competitive play. You can't buy higher level characters in Overwatch. You can't buy more boost in Rocket League. What a joke.

Gameplay is fun but the game is entirely pay to win. If you aren't willing to spend money, you're going to have an awful time. Matchmaking pairs you vs players with higher leveled cards and king towers. The progression system is insanely slow. The balancing in the game is wildly lackluster. If you aren't planning on spending money, I do not recommend this game at all.

Super fun game, I can play with my friends and it is super engaging and fun to use on long road trips and just whenever I have downtime. Huge issue: it is completely pay to win. It is ridiculous to have to play people that are above you in level and skill. The only way to play them is to pay, which is really dumb. The last update was COMPLETÈLY unnecessary and stupid. Please make your game better.

This game used to be so much fun and one that I'd play with all my friends. Over the past year, however, Supercell has taken some of the most fun and rewarding things out of the game. They've raised the level cap, and turned to pass royale into a "give us all your money" type beat along with countless other things. This game may be beyond saving.

This game's goal is not to entertain you, but to make you buy at least something. The internal store is not an option, it is a prerequisite. A very large number of players with legendary cards and cards that you can only get through three or four arenas. Only a cyber-athlete who created a new account for fun will be able to play comfortably and grow at low levels.

This game used to be fun, but now it's a money-making scheme. When I went to inquire in the help section, they lied to me multiple times and tried to make it seem as though it was my problem even though I had proof it wasn't. I'm sick of this. 😔

i have been playing this game since its launch... about 9 years ago. Was one of my favourite games. However over the last few years the game became so much pay to win is incredible. You cannot compete without spending as you cant keep up with the new cards and new evolutions. Also it is so obvious that once you start winning the game gives you the worst matchups in order to go down again. Its a never ending cycle. I just deteleted it and i strongly advise to stay away from this game.

With each update they make the game worse and worse. It is anti consumer and anti free to play, as to have any meaningful progression you need to spend money. This is already annoying enough, but add to that the fact that the pricing is horrendous, and you get a terrible progression system. The base game is fun enough one you get to max level, but of course to do that you must spend money, and all of the other game modes they add aren't fun, they are very basic. Do not recommend

The game at lower levels is luring and habit forming. It draws unbalanced game for you to finally make a purchase for good cards. Fraudulent by design. They think people won't understand their trickery.

Tbh, this game is a quick crashgrab. If you're thinking about playing this game, just keep in mind that 90% of your progress speed is counting on how much you spend in the game. Level 15 has to be one of the most HORRENDOUS uptade added to this game. Horrible but hopefully still fixable. Hopefully the devs finally start listenin

Recently I've seen many negative reviews, and to make sure you can see both sides of the coin I am sharing my opinion. This is one of the best games for mobiles. People complain about card upgrading, they say it's too long, and you can speed up this process with purchases, you can, but it doesn't affect gameplay, only your skill will, enjoy

Came back and had fun, was able to upgrade to elite pretty quickly. I even bought a pass cause I was happy with the rewards and gameplay. Then they decided to do another money grab, changed everything making it impossible to upgrade. Completely unplayable for anyone not spending massive amounts of money again. Greed killed the gameplay. Leaving again. Apparently $50 million a month isn't enough for them.

Years of play removed the shine.Most notably, the matching algorithm is garbage. The most generous interpretation is that you're forever matched against your best day. It's maddening when you just want a chest. I enjoy the gameplay, even if devs currently hate swarm mechanics. However, I am irritated by the chest timer mechanic, and the incessant demands for reviews are beyond annoying. That being said, it does seem to be a good game, even if the chest timers are -extraordinarily- frustrating.

This game always had a pay to win element, but after almost 5 years of playing, Supercell has turned their greed to overdrive, and largely ignores the feedback from their players. At this point, it's no longer fun to play, as you HAVE to spend just to be competitive. Avoid the game, unless you want to spend a lot of money on an old game that doesn't draw new players.

Greedy. The only thing the developers have in mind is fattening their own pockets. The recent balance changes and taking away the season shop while also implementing this new ranked system made the game (somehow) even more pay to win. They finally made the game utterly and completely unplayable. Congratulations! It's a fun game nonetheless and there's no other like it but I won't be playing it, unless something changes.

I don't see how a game that is so unbalanced as far as match ups are concerned deserves more than 1 star. If you pay to play I'm sure the game is more fun but, I will never waste my hard earned money on something that I can't physically own. The game is free to play to a certain point but, once you've reached that point good luck. You are pitted against max level cards to a point that is ridiculous and takes the fun out of the game completely.

Clash Royale is a very fun (and addictive) game. It is a extremely exciting mobile game, that forces you to stay calm under pressure. It is a fantastic game overall, except that it's pay-to-win. It's SUCH a big frustration, because, unlike a lot of other games, you don't pay for cosmetics. You actually pay for the most overleveled stuff. I don't pay a cent, and it is really hard to keep up with all the overleveled/pay2win players out there.

this game is great, but the time it takes to evolve cards is so slow, most other players pay for them in seconds, especially in later stages of the game, you critically depend on evo cards. I spent a full year to evo one card, and my friend paid for three off the bat, instantly jumping a quarter of the game. It is very much a pay to play game and no longer fun, yet still highly addicting.

Game has kept me interested for a few years. Only major negative is that it's a money pit. Updates are usually amazing. Boat race sucked at first nI still hate being limited to one play every 24 hrs for the clan. Just when I'm getting bored, they update, bring a new card, and change things up. There's a reason this game has been around so long. It's because they never stop working on it. They're never content and always changing with player feedback. It's that dedication that keeps it awesome.

The concept of the game is fun, yes, the execution is terrible. What used to be a fun game has, in the past few years, turned into a terrible pay to win game. Supercell, being the greedy company they are, of course make it so that if you're a free to play player, the progression takes years, and after a certain point is just plainly impossible without the need to spend money. They're removing free ways to progress, and making it so you have to pay. And they don't nerf OP pay to win cards.

There's to much parity in the game. Players use the easiest, cheapest cards and spam them and there's nothing you can do about it. It makes the game repetitive and boring. The paywalls are also absolutely absurd. Supercell tries so hard to get youre money rather than make the game more enjoyable. I've played this game on and off for about 7 years and it has gone downhill because of the repetitive game play.

I've been playing this game since the year it came out. Sometimes in the past, they introduced shards. These let your character be more elite. Little did I know this was just a way to benefit to pay-to-play players. After what feels like a year of the shards being released, ice earned a grand total of 2 of them. They developers have found a way to advantage paying players while holding non paying ones down. I'm about done.

Wow, this update... I've been playing CR since almost the very beginning, and I've seen it grow from the basic 1v1, to Clan Wars, to Pay-per-season, etc. I understood supporting the developers with the $5.99, but now for the same exact thing they're asking $11.99? Really? I've been paying the $5.99 a month, but this seems very greedy and I'm very close to Uninstalling the game and finding something else to give my time and money to. More than double for the same thing... disappointing.

Update - now it's even more obvious that paying players are given the advantage. Meeting same or lower level opponents with higher level cards all the time. Additionally, strange things are happening to save opponents when they are losing. Google should take this game out of the store and review what is going on, fewls like a complete scam now. Pay to win. If you don't pay you will not get ANY good cards. The paying players have an edge that is impossible to handle if you don't pay.

Game was a lot of fun for years. Then came tencent. Since they purchased Supercell, it's been downhill fast. This latest champions update with level 14 was the last straw for me. Just another in a long series of attempts to get their greedy fingers on my wallet. Playing War Alliance now. It's actually fun. Thanks for ruining a once great game.

It's really hard to make progress, even if you buy the gold pass, which was nerfed severely in the latest update. Plus, the amount of grind for high level cards increased drastically with the introduction of level 15. This makes it difficult even for paid players to achieve maxed decks, and completely annihilates the already slow progress of the free-to-play. It's now the biggest grind since DS3 single player covenant farming. Or, you could shell over hundreds of dollars to speed things up.

Clash Royale used to be one of my favorite games. The strategy provided interesting gameplay, the progression was fun, and you felt accomplished. However, as of late, it seems that the dev team is making the WORST possible choice with every update. Evolutions were broken for almost their entire lifetime and continue to be troublesome, limited modes and challenges are less fun, clan war is uninteresting, and now progression has been MURDERED. I don't understand why these things had to happen.

It's been fun playing this game. I've made friends over it, had fun with it, and enjoyed playing it casually. That said, I can't honestly say it's fun to play anymore. Between the major battle pass (season pass) nerf and it's increased price, and this absurd, unbalanced, lazy, and free2play punishing excuse for an update, I can definitively say that both playing the game casually, and spending money on it in any way is barely to not worth it anymore. Sad supercell, you ruined something great

Latest update is broken and hangs on startup while showing "Account alert" dialog. The review below is for older version of this game. Probably the best game created by Supercell. I think it's not worth using real money because early stages are the best part of the game and that's the part that you can skip with little real world money. The resources you get in the game grow linearly but the prices go up exponentially. Expect to pay hundreds of dollars if you want top cards with shortcuts...

I used to play this game 7 years ago and came back because of nostalgia. It has changed a lot, mostly for the worse. The cards now are more unbalanced than ever, which killed deck diversity. In the trophy mode, the game punishes you for winning, as you end up with fewer and underleveled cards against stronger opponents. Unless you are planning to play with friends, I don't recommend.

Very fun game! I have had it since the release. There are a few things that feel like supercell is trying too hard but it is still fun. However... I PAID for the seasonal "Pass Royale" and played so much that I got to the end of the pass. I was getting "lucky loop" chests that cost 20 crowns (several wins) each. I continued to play and now I am "maxed out" on reward chest. This is very discouraging to me as I PAID for the extra rewards... I will most likely NOT spend more money on this game...

Overall the game is fun, the new updates seem to correct some of the errors from the previous release. We are probably still stuck being beat by the exact same clans for a month. Magic items help lvl cards... which is good but makes it quicker to get a brand new card maxed, which makes the fun of getting specific cards less appealing. If you have all cards maxed on a specific tier, you cant request cards of that type, but you should be able to request ANY card due to needing star points.

This new update is a scam! Just right when the game was finally improving and they do this to us. Also, you need to add a way to opt out players that don't attack in clan wars. This game has too many issues already and you guys aren't solving them, instead you keep adding more and more problem to the game. #NoLvl14

Used to love this game, started playing with guys from work several years ago when the game was still fresh. Finally uninstalled this game. After multiple years of trying to make it work, I'm done. The pay to win aspects are just too egregious. This game is well ,how should I say this without being rude ,not in its best ,but it is worthy a try. I mean ,it could be better but I still like spending my free time trying to beat other players. Downloaded the game at launch and played fairly consistently since with only a few breaks. Loved this game, but the current pay-to-play system with level 15 cards and evolutions is ridiculous. Supercell has ruined their game and turned it the most disappointing money pit. I'm by no means against a company monetizing their game, and have in fact spent a fair amount of money on Clash Royale. Legendary cards are not worth nearly what they are priced in shop. 40k for an ice wizard? Ludicrous. The lumberjack is a great example of a good legendary card. Fast, but can only attack 1 target at a time; upon death, however, he drops rage, which is very useful for support style cards, like anti-air. I do LOVE this game, and that's why I want to see it get even better. A few balancing changes and thus would be golden. Btw, I do LOVE the change you made with micro-transactions, as it does seem worth it to pay for chests that have special attributes like picking your own cards or striking out ones you may not want. I love this game and just want to see it go in a positive way.

This game was perfect when It released. The only thing they focused on is the shop lol. It's really boring to play it these days. And btw, I'm a high level player so don't think I wrote this review because I'm bad or anything else. I just want to share my opinion on a game which I missed its old version.

Recently, came back to game. Found it impossible to make your way up trophy road. The amount of bots they have programmed into the game to fill games quickly is insane. Every second game you vs a bot, check their stats, generic names, pictures and they have thousands of wins. The bots have perfect counters to everything you put down and is virtually impossible to progress. They are killing their game in search of making money, tricking people into spending real money to get better cards.

The game used to be good: You get chests, up your card levels, enjoy and that's it. Now it's not about who has better strategy, it's about who has more money into their accounts. Absolutely ridiculous. If you want to burn some cash, this game is what you're looking for.

I was playing since 2021, and a lots have changed till now. I can say that most of it wasn't to shabby, but it always created that constant feeling of the game just being more and more expensive. HEROES+LVL16?? You aren't even hiding it anymore, you steal our money

The game was fun when it came out, but slowly over the years Supercell has changed what made the game good. It's so bad it's possible to softlock progression at the very start of the game. This review isn't so change can happen. it's to bring down the overall rating in a collective group effort. I would have choice words for you, Supercell but then you have a valid reason to take this down. I'm simply upset. That is all. Thank you.

This was a pretty neat game, I've been playing since late 2016. I loved clash, but they're killing their player base with all these horrible updates. With lvl 15, the game will be less fun for all of the f2p player's because they don't wanna spend money to progress in a game that claims to be free. I also hate how they did the different game modes. I think the season shop is alright, but the fact that we don't get crowns for it is absolute bs.

I've been playing this game for nearly a decade now and the most recent update has made me stop playing. I didn't love how long chests would take and progression felt painfully slow for years but with daily lucky drops, the battle pass, and the season shop. It felt faster then ever. That is, until they cut the battle pass rewards in half, got rid of chests and the season shop and changed the daily rewards. I have played this game for a long time, but this was the final straw for me. I give up.

This game can be fun, but will likely end up being frustratingly painful for many. The truth is the game requires tons of work to be put in as you will need to level up your cards, your tower, and work quite a bit to get enjoyment out of the game. But even despite putting all the work in, this game is plagued with many issues: certain deck combos being favorable, some cards being a bit too strong, being part of a clan, and the level gap making many games unfair or screwed. Good Luck.

It used to be a great game, but got pay to win in recent years. But I can look past that, whatever you need to do to keep up sales I guess. But let me spin you a tale of horrid customer service. Ive had an account pretty much since launch, but lost it because I deleted the email account linked to the supercell ID when I was inactive for a long time. While trying to recover the account, I've given details only the account holder would know, but was banned for 31 days. Seven times.

I had a good review up for years, but this game is now a shadow of what it once was. last few updates murdered progression, rewards, and even the audio is now butchered. This newest update has changed/destroyed the foundation of a nearly 10 year old game, and the few remaining non-pay-to-win aspects are completely gone. thanks for that. and also thanks for automatically opening the 8 year old chest I had saved since Arena 4. this game is unplayable.

Fix the matchmaking. 600 trophy difference? How is that fun for people who haven't played since day 1 or spending $$ for years? Used to be a blast, now it's a money grab to balance the playing field. UPDATE 2024: Even worse. Pay to win - - >pay to play. Playing this game without spending a ton of money is just feeding the players that actually have paid an insane amount. I've spent money on the pass, and bundles from time to time; without a consistent investment, you are nothing.

This game was gotten so much worse with the unfairness. It's obvious that some game you have no chance at winning. When you play no clan bot, they always have exactly the right characters to beat you, and you can tell they get the potion so much faster than you can. This game is a total pay to win game now, and it has just sucked all the fun out of playing it. It's near impossible to move up the tiers or ranks without paying for it. Don't bother down loading this it with just irritati you.

I've been playing since 2016, and it was such a good f2p game. Unfortunately, they have been rolling out horrible updates that make it so you have to pay to play the game. If you're looking at starting the game, I don't recommend it. They took the chest away and limited how many lucky drops you can get in a day. So unless you're spending money, then you can't advance fast.

I used to think this game was great, but honestly by this point it's the worst money grab I've ever seen on Google Play store. They make you think you're strong, then the matchmaking throws you against near impossible opponents, making you feel the need to spend money in order to keep playing and progressing. And when you do, the matchmaking somehow gets worse and you don't see any progression. Every new update ruins something people loved and limits the game more, forcing unwanted purchases.

You downloaded the game, starts out fun, then you spend hours playing. Past 2000 trophies you will run into p2w players, anything past 4500 and the game is basically pay to play, you cannot constantly rank up without spending money or running into someone who spent their families whole salary to be good at the game, doesn't matter how good you are at thinking the highest payer always wins, you get to a point where you are fighting max level decks with level 11 cards and you don't have a choice.

This is the worst update I've seen to date for this game. No chests for 2v2 matches, long waits, and the caps on earning stuff from challenges, 2v2, etc. at 1,000 tokens is just dumb. I play maybe 10 minutes a day now and then turn off the game, whereas I played for hours before. As the leader of my clan, I have a standing order to demote anyone who buys the pass. Fortunately, the 20 or so who usually buy it (myself included) have not bought it. Screw your greed!

this game is basically unplayable for people who don't spend anything on it. if you don't buy the battle pass, which is horrendously overpriced, you don't stand a chance of climbing at all. rng favours those who put money into the game. you will always be in a bad matchup with under leveled cards if you don't pay. Supercell should really offer refunds on the gold that is spend on a card when they rework it. All of the time and gold has now gone to waste. No point in playing this game at all now

The devs are seriously killing this game by not listening to the community & making the game a disgustingly money grabbing situation where you need to spend lots and lots of money to be able to compete in a fair way. It's a shame becuase it has so much potential but the game is just running into a thick wall. And let me be more clear, level 15 simply sucks & we do not need it!

Used to be a fun strategy game, but now it’s just a cash grab. The developers clearly imbalance the game on purpose to push players into spending money. Progress is ridiculously slow unless you pay, and new overpowered cards are introduced just to milk the paying players. If you're not spending, well, good luck... It’s gone from skill-based to wallet-based. Disappointing.

Please fix the emote glitch in the shop. I'm missing 2 emotes, yes they are regular not exclusive. Since I'm not missing 3 and only 2..I'm guessing that triggers the glitch, of the last 2 no appearing. I have reached out to you'll, but no effort has been put in to resolve. I have spend hundreds, been playing the game since first day. Not asking for free things just asking to correct this. I'll give it 5 star review if this gets addressed, since I do enjoy the game. Thank you.

Overall, this is a great free mobile game. It can be very competitive, while having an edge to players who pay for certain things, everything is still achievable for free. Great art work changes recently, some nice improvements with the banners, and my favorite as of late; the mastery challenges. There is a lot of strategy in this game with the 107 cards, while some of the limited time events introducing some interesting cards just for those events. Overall, I've had tons of fun for 6 years.

At first I thought this game is gonna be at least alright in terms of strategy but it turns out that if you don't have the card, no matter what strategy you use, you are destined to loose the game. Specific cards like Baby Dragon, Skeleton Army, and etc are cards that will give you a really high advantage which in turn guarantees your opponent's loss. Also, the card selection just sucks. You can't view a card's abilities just because you don't have it or not in the level to have it? What??

Player and spender of more than 8 years and now is finally the time to completely cancel this game. It started with legendary characters and they have done it again with the champions. We accepted all this,but level 15 ?! Ridiculous decision by dev ops. They could have pivoted and made money through so many other ways but they have given up and are now resorting to take in as much money as possible to the point where they are okay if it kills the game. Capitalism 1 Gaming community 0

After a while opponents seem to be picked purely based on your decks weaknesses and you fall so behind, it's not worth the anguish of 20 losses in a row. Edit: I recently tried to log back in because there are absolutely NO games worth the time on Google play anymore. Everything gets boring and I'm about done altogether with gaming. To conclude, the support team could not help me get my account back unless I gave them proof of purchase. I have my account! What more do you need?!

Prior to wars 2.0, I had given this game a rating of 5 stars. The old style of wars required building a level capped deck from a limited pool of cards and required real skill to build well and because of the level cap, all players were on a level playing field. You were required to play 1.5 matches per day with opt out. All of that said enter wars 2.0 where you can't opt out, there isn't a level cap, and you are required to play 4 matches per round. Clan died from this update.

Just came back to the game after 3 years, and it's a pure nightmare, if you're planning to come back and give this game another go, please don't for the sake of your own sanity. The constant pay-to-win forcing, and locking broken units behind pay walls is really saddening, considering how good the game originally was. It has gone to shambles and is down in the dirt right now.

If you are new to the game, and play against live players at the start, they'll have higher level mob than yours. I complete run you over and not sticking to the same level comparison, they could use money to buy the cards to level up while they are at the start, that's a big disadvantage for new players that want to play this game. I like the game, but can't deal with the pay the win stuff.

I've been playing since the beginning, 100% f2p. I'm at lvl 13, I've got 13 maxed cards right now. I'm missing some sort of goal. I'm slowly maxing card after card, even legendaries, through requesting. Playing the game does not really further this, there are hardly any rewards I want which could make me push trophies. I'm just logging in three times a day to do the routine and that's it.

For someone who played this game since its beta stage back in 2016, it's saddening for me to write this review. The stark difference between this and Clash of Clans, is how terribly greedy the pricing strategy of this game has become. Two kinds of season pass subscriptions and overpriced cosmetics. You even got that piggybank nonsense crammed into the game. So many unnecessary updates as well. I remember back then when the game didn't even reach 100 MBs in size. Now it's almost half a gig.

I have played this game since it's launch. I am sad to say the following: This game is a money grab entirely, the strategy and fun went out the window a few years ago. Every subsequent update has made the game less engaging and rewarding. They have consistently ignored player requests and have worsened the experience for players not wanting to spend hundreds of dollars on a rock paper scissors mobile game.

Gambling: The Game If your opponent's troops and towers are higher level, they win. If you're equal, you get good gameplay. If you're more leveled, you win. You need to play for 2-3 hours to get the same progress as feom spending a dollar. Leveling up is trivial if you're paying. Be ready to throw away games if you're opponent has a high level.

It's a really fun game to be honest, but it's p2w, for example, evolutions. You can buy them from the shop but if you're f2p you have to wait 3 months to even get 1 Evo, and I get that everyone is p2w and they all have higher level cards. But skill is important too, but if there's a too significant level difference there's just no way to win, still kinda fun to come back to time to time but it's just so aggravating when you proceed to reach 1 game away from next arena you lose indefinitely.

After playing this game for almost 10 years, I'm finally deleting it. Once you reach a certain level and win a trophy, the game starts favoring your opponents in the next few levels. In the recent update, they even removed the chests, which is extremely frustrating. I'm no longer playing this game, and with these kinds of changes, more people will probably stop playing it too.

Previous rating 5 stars just down vote 2 stars I've been playing this game since launch, almost 3 years ago. And it has been a blast. Last year they implemented a pay by month "service" pass royal. This month I felt it wasn't worth 5 bucks, so I passed on it. WTAF! You can play this game and get rewards but at a fraction of the pace you were once able to, it is nearly unplayable. If you haven't already played this game of haven't played in a while - DON'T. Supercell will soak you for everything

Played it for almost 7 years and I must say, they are trying really hard to get players into paying. It became pay2win and that's just sad because it really had potential. Since they published tower level 15, I'm being spammed with offers, where I can upgrade my card to level 15 for "only" 7,99€. On the other hand, if you don't pay, you really have to grind in the game to upgrade only one card to level 15, it's ridiculous. The evolutions are pay2win as well- either play for 6 months or pay 15€

Support for this game is non-existent. We have had a player harassing members of our clan for more than a year. After several months and hundreds of reports, it appeared to be resolved but the player has returned and has started harassing members so much that they are leaving the game entirely. Also if you get deployed and cant access the game for a period of time, they give control of your clan, that you used currency to create, to someone else with no option to take back control when you can.

It wasn't a fun experience. At first, when everyone has the same cards, it was pretty fair gameplay. Everyting was fun at that point. But later on people began buying cards with money and absolutely destroying. I had no chance. I would like for the legendaries to be nerfed, or at least the ability of buying them with money be removed.

This game used to be really fun. Now, it's nearly impossible to win a battle or progress in the game. The gold cost to upgrade a higher level character is 75k-100k and therefore takes a long time to be able to upgrade your characters. It seems I am always paired with players that have characters maxed out, making it impossible to win. The game is more frustrating than fun.

The "Update for Losers" will result in this game never getting another dollar from me. I purchased the event pass monthly, but they continue to make it more difficult to allow us to play together, and have now removed pretty much any reward for doing so. They might as well just remove 2v2 instead of burying it in deeper and deeper menus, and now you can't just click play again, that too was removed. Be better, or I, like many others will simply jump ship to that new game coming outsoon

Don't even waste your time. By my third game I was facing a Pay To Win player with units that ran over mine like they were ants. Game doesn't even try to lure you in with a slow curve. Its Pay To Win from the very start and strategy involved in unit decisions is meager at best. You're essentially just throwing units at each other. A very similar game thats more balanced (in the beginning) is World War Doh. Play that instead.

Pretty good game, until arena 6 when it becomes pay to win. The game markets itself as a strategy game, but after a while it just becomes a matter of who has the highest card and king levels, which is directly controlled by how much money you pump into the game. Also there are the legendary cards which are really rare (easy to get if you pay a lot though) and some are really overpowered. Fun in the beginning, boring pay to win "game" after a few hours.

They've truly outdone themselves. I thought the level 15 update would be the worst they've ever conceived, but they truly put their full wits and will together and went out of their way to compose the worst update by far. I had already given up on the game a bit ago, but even hearing about this update drove me to the point of even having it on my phone. I've been dedicated to the game for quite some time, reaching GM and such. The game has had a good run, but as all things do, it has truly died

Been playing on and off for 9+ years. I want to play, but I can't anymore. UI is way too flashy like a casino, trying to get you to spend every last penny you have on their game. They want you to click 10,000 things in the menu and click all these random buttons to collect free rewards or rewards in general. I enjoyed the game before it felt like a flashy casino.

pay to win. that's all this is is, a credit card simulator. if u don't spend hundreds of dollars you can not stand a fair chance against people with cards 2 or 3 levels higher. heros are insane strong and if u want to get one it's ten bucks or a long wait for a random chance to get the one you want. evos are just as slow but at least I can pick the ones I want. the game was ok the first time I played now it's just a money grab. honestly sad about that bc it's a cool and fun concept.

Worst algorithm in the history of gaming! It is mind blowing how bad it is! If you are not paying to play you won't get past a certain point because they match you to lose more often than not. I have been playing since a couple of months after the game was launched and the more you advance the worse it gets. This is a revised review of this game because it use to be amazing until they became all about pay to win and have done nothing since day one to improve their algorithm.

Listen, I can have a lot of fun playing this game, but it also has the capacity to make me unnaturally angry. There's a lot of reasons for it, but fundamentally, card games can do something to some people. Try the game, play YOUR way, using the decks that YOU like, and if that's good enough for you to keep going then I'm glad and hope you can find the same enjoyment I can, at times. But if the game is genuinely difficult to have fun with, don't play it so much, if at all.

Losing the fun, becoming increasingly annoying. Been playing over 3 years & frequently end seasons at master 2. It's often paring me up with past champion level players & i get slaughtered game after game. Also spent time & some money to increase deck levels, only for it to be "rebalanced", which screws up my strategy. Still a fun game at times, but definitely losing the alure & likelyhood of me spending anymore cash.

Overall the game is the best game. It easy to get into a game and you can trade cards with you clan mates. Sometimes I get a message saying that a chest is open and fifty present of the time it is ready to be opened. Also the most of the cards when you get up to when you get your first lengerdy card they start to cost 5-10 so you just can't spam them. In conclusion I think that it is a very good and fun game to play. Yes there are pros and cons and it is really fun to play

Encompassing strategy, player wit, and utilization of over 96 playable cards and millions of deck creation opportunity, the game opens up many options and holds very little restriction to what agency the player can have, despite meta decks being a problem or the occassional balancing issue, but is to be expected. Although the game can be won without the use of in-game purchases, it will take more chances than not to make you want to with special chests, gold, and gems, but gameplay is managable.

This game is definitely awesome, however there's a bug I incountered and even I tried to clear the data of this app and kog in to my previous account, the bug was still there. The bug I incountered is there's a notification in my magic items that won't disappear. It is so disturbing to look at. And that's all, I hope you will be able to fix it.

This is a great game! The gameplay is great and doesn't get old, the graphics are simple yet great, and generally a great game. As much as I'd love to give this app a five star review, recently since the new update my game crashes on the loading screen. I get that things like this happen but I can't help but feel annoyed, as I am now going to be kicked from my clan for missing war. Anyways, great game, just please fix this issue.

Addicting and infuriating, the matchmaking has been heavily critized and I respect that, but my issue is that the game so far has experienced not one, not two but numerous crashes during or at the end of a match and its either the game itself or the internet connection but its never been this often that this happens. I've played the game since launch and it still holds up as a fun game but jeez too many crashes

I've been playing this game for over 6 years and honestly, I really liked it at first. Recently it has become boring for me. There are a lot of characters in the game in a short time. Therefore, it made some old characters ineffective and worthless and you cannot use them. Also, when you reach an advanced level, if you play in an offensive way, you will not go far in the game, unlike playing in a defensive and frustrating way. It's not the same as playing became frustrating

I am changing my 5⭐ to 1⭐. I loved this game and have been playing for over 6 years and recently the game is modified to do good only for people who spend money and buy the royal pass. The matchmaking has also become very unfair and not at all encouraging to play. They only give you hard encounters and it is such that every game you play is designed for you to lose. The gameplay has become very demotivating. Hope the developers read this

Gameplay is very good, but the game itself since a few updates is just 'pay to win'. Honestly your skill level doesn't matter anymore. You can straight up buy yourself huge advantages over other players using your money. And this is not something I will accept in a game that tries to be 'competitive'. I mean I want to compete with my skill, not with my wallet.

Matchmaking is ridiculous. Essentially, you cannot fight on a leveled playing field unless you have been playing for years or spend hundreds of $$ which will only get you to a even matchup. Extremely not recommended for new players. Would be a great game if it wasnt for the intentional lack of balancing. Edit: Clan Wars 2 is here. They've officially taken out the last thing left in this game that had any real balancing or leveled playing field. They're really just in it for the money now.

DON'T install it. The app crashes, there's lag, connection breakdowns, player matches way below and above our gamer's skills. Lately, you sometimes can't place your card onto the field which leads to a lost battle. Oh, not to mention when your opponent starts before you! Why am I still playing it? Because I've played for 3 years and I'll wait for a change.

Have been playing the game for a while. Initally I really liked the game and had fun with the clan I'm in. However since the release of the new clan wars, I've also lost interest in the game unfortunately. As the clan wars was one of my favorite things to do. I still like the game from time to time but then only for one game and then am done again. Quite sad to see the game going from 5 stars for me to 2..

Laggy at crucial moments, as if the game is trying to make you lose. Additionally, high level people crash their trophy level to play in lower tiers, so your perpetually fighting overleveled people and clearly the game has not attempted to solve the issue. Frustrating waste of time, and I regret spending money on this game. Also, the "strike" system is super rigged. Whenever you use it to reroll your cards, it always rotates through the same sequence of bad cards in the same order.

This game was fun when it started. They keep messing with the cards saying they are unfairly balanced. They aren't. It's the people who don't understand strategy games and how to properly use the cards that's the problem. Now all the cards suck, even witch & bomber skeleton. The new players want it all. They want all maxed out cards but they don't want to work for it. It took me over a year for my first legendary card, and it was the log... Get over it. It's legendary rarity for a reason.

Game was really good until they decided to implement the "season pass" It's obvious that if you do not buy it, you will never pass a certain level ! I've given this game 5 stars before, but now, I removed it and give it only 1 , and I do think it's too much. As someone else said, the giant has fallen... Sad but true. Is there a way to give 0 stars? Gold diggers... Don't pay and get frustrated. They will do whatever they can to take your money. Do not fall for this.

I have quit this game because I had a battle pass but forgot to collect the items. All I asked was for the cosmetics which I had been collecting since the first battle pass and was told since this had happened once before they would not give me the items. Bogus. Now that I can never have a complete set after I had paid and completed it I wont play or recommend this game again.

This game is very fun and takes a lot of skill and time. It does however have some issues. The servers are just generally laggy even if you have a good connection, and for a game that requires precise placement and time it is quite frustrating when the servers don't function very well. It is also very much pay to win and it is very easy to get angry when you get put against someone who shouldn't be playing against you. Its a fun game but look out for these things if your considering playing it.

This is no doubt a pay to win game. The upgrade towards the high levels are way too expensive. We should have the option of degrading cards and get back a portion of the gold spent when we upgraded the card. The match making algorithm is garbage. You would experience a very frustrating losing streak for no apparent reason. Trophies you patiently worked hard for many days would be gone in just a matter of minutes. This game is not for fun and recreation. Zero stars if I could. 👎👎👎

The game is good at base. Much better than clash of clans. The issues lie in its pay to win structure. Of course there's the common fool that will say its worth it to pay, but those who don't are immediately at a huge disadvantage and just can't advance too far. It is still fun to form a clan and play with your friends though, so there is some worth in this game.

The game is unplayable. Lags horribly, frequently crashes or freezes mid-game. Played several games where I lost while in the loading screen 😐. Why not add a few second timer before we can rush each other? And the matchmaking is horrible! I was patnered with a lvl 8 with lvl 6 troops while my oppnents were 12 with max cards. I can wait a few seconds in matchmaking if it means a more fair fight.

The game is very unbalanced, and pay to win. I get matched with players who have all level 12+ cards while I'm still stuck on level 10 cards because the free-to-play rewards are garbage. In addition evolution cards are the cherry on top of pay to win. The 2v2 Mode is a bad idea. Teammates leave during the game, without any penalty. Which makes it impossible to win. The challenges are worthless to do, as you get close to nothing out of them. Overall, this game could be better.

It's a pretty cool game, but with the current patch you seemed to have ruined the game making passes cost so much, you have ruined the concept of path of legends, why not make that terrible time consuming game mode a separate place like the old party system. The games too clunky and full of to many things to do before you get into a simple match. I've been playing the game for years and I loved it and it's very sad for me but the update is pushing me away from playing the game.

Latest android version is so buggy. You are shown start screen but game almost ended!!! Fix it!!! Game can be fun but most of the time it is about matching algorithm not about strategy. Looks like you are A/B tested and capped at winning. Also about 10 to 20% of the time, you get players that play throw away games. Poor versioning and requiring force updates at least 3 times last 2 weeks. App crashed and there was no way to recover account. Ridicilous!

Love the game. I never really got into CoC but for some reason this game has me hooked on getting new cards and building new strategies. The only drawback is that getting both currency and cards takes so long. It would be nice to be able to unlock extra slots for chests and have all of them opening at once. Even if that was something you could unlock with gems, it would be worthwhile for players to hold on to them rather than just use them to speed up the painfully slow waiting process.

While this was pretty fun originally this game has made some poor choices. Just a few of them are pay to win being completely broken (like every mobile game) not having skill based match making in clan wars (I've run into people both above and below me). Some of the auditions are helping like lucky drops but, when I'm always fighting someone who is either to low level to even compare to me or so over leveled I couldn't even begin to touch him thats a problem. It's fun, but pay 2 win now. There's a slight unbalance with certain units that are very obviously a little too good. This by itself is fine. It's when you try to play the game and someone has cards you can't get for another 7 arenas cause they bought them. Not to mention, gold, card evolutions, and wild cards are pay to win, too. Yes, there are free ways to get these things, but it takes a long time compared to buying, and it's obvious that who does and doesn't spend money.

If you want to see what pay to win games feel like - download this game. People can buy in, and get access to mid-late game units while you are still learning. Even their basic units are stronger than yours because they can pay to power them up. It's hardly a strategy game even, more luck based depending on the type of deck you and your opponent build. It's fun, it's addictive, but i wouldn't recommend it. However, super impressive matchmaking times. 2-5 seconds average.

The last probably 10 times I've played a multiplayer match my teammate has left. And I'm not allowed to leave until the game I'm playing is over making it extremely frustrating when I want to play another game afterwards. This has been a problem for years that clash royal has done absolutely nothing to fix or even acknowledge. DO NOT DOWNLOAD!!!!!

A total waste of time and money. In level 9 with just two legendary cards. Received two war chests with 1 in 5 chance of legendary but you guessed it, no legendary card. Dropped to level 7 due to not having cards as opponent. In order to win you have to spend tons of cash. Dont waste your time and effort to reach high levels when you will lose almost every battle .

I am playing this game since November 2022 and I love this game too much. I have purchased some stuffs too. That was too exciting to play. But now it's lagging to much. That was very fun to play before 😭. Now I don't know what's happening. Pls do something for me.

This game is a joke now. It didn't use to be like this, but now, 20 seconds into the match you can tell who got host. Especially with the halloween matches. I have noticed that if you purchase the season pass, the match making algorithm is much friendlier... but then again, this review might not even matter because it most likely will get burried and forgotten because of its content.

Updated: Honestly it's an okay game. The problems arise with match ups against much stronger players in one on one, and people leaving battles in 2v2. There is no way to report players for bad behavior in the latter and both make it nearly impossible to win. Enjoyment is QUICKLY impacted by these issues. Plus, I stress tested the temporary play restriction for abandoning 2V2 matches and it's a joke. In short it's worth playing for fun but not for putting any money into.

If you Are looking for a Game where you get to be creative in deckbuilding, you have Come to the wrong place. Played this Game since the beginning and it only got worse. In the upper ranks you can virtually choose 2 Decks, because nothing else is played and everything else is getting nerfed. Cant recommend this Game anymore. Especially for Newcomers it is Hard to reach the competetive Level. It is either paying or grinding for 1 year (not exeggerated). Dont waste Your time.

Cannot level up unless you spend money, been playing since it started and can't even get all the cards because I can't get to the higher level. If I spend money I win some. Used to play this game when it first came out. Clash Royale is a pretty good strategy game. It has a great graphics along with good gameplay. The battle algorithm is quite good too. But I am not so satisfied with the controls. It runs slow on 1 GB RAM smartphones. Plus, it charges highly on mobile data. Supercell should put the whole game in a 90 megabyte package. I had another problem when playing it on PC via bluestacks and Gameloop. It faces problems and a lot of lagging. So, supercell should also create a PC version of this game.

The game is a greedy mess. Every game is about atrition and it drags on forever. The shop and progression are set up so you can spend as much money as possible while having as little fun. The battle pass is also worse for free users. They are not even hiding it at this point. Evolutions are just straight up OP and impossible to get if you dont pay or grind. Very sad to see this game in this state. I wouldn't recommend unless you play with some friends.

Now I don't normally write too many reviews, but this game was special to me. Now I'm no FTP player, I did spend money on the pass back when it was actually good value, but when they reworked it I stopped. And with level 15, one of my friends bought the deal that gave you a level 15 and he did that for 3 cards. I feel so far behind now because I don't want to spend more money. Level 15 in the first place was just a horrible idea. (I would talk about how evolutions suck too but I'm out of space)

Been playing since launch. Was absolutely amazing up until the last big update. Evolution is cool...but overpowered...and they are harder to get unlocked as champions. And don't get me started on level 15. I have since removed the game from my playing list. They have obviously just tried to focus on pay to win in the game as of the last 3 updates and if I wanted that I would play Raid...

I loved this game and played it daily for 3 years.  I unlocked chests within a few hours on a regular basis and got maxed main deck because of this. With the most recent update chests will  reset (golden chests in particular) within hours of being unlocked.  This has made me play it far less - which I guess isn't a bad thing. But I'm also far less likely to make another microtransation for season two next month with a broken game. I will update review when this is fixed.

Clash Royal has been the only game on my phone that withstood time and replayability. I've been playing for more than 5yrs and have spent loads of money. I have to say that the last update (a week ago) is really bad. One issue is the monthly $4.99 pass is now $5.99! Why!? Now there's a $11.99 pass!? This now feels like a money grab. 😢 😭 Time to find a new game.

Unbalanced. It's fun until it's not. It's a pay to win game . It also need some type of rank system based on troops rank not trophy count. Until the game does that I don't think it will be a really good game till these changes are made. Maybe one day this will be a good game, but I doubt it since it's a massive cash grab. The game has a 2 tier system monthly pass. If you don't buy it, the game punishes you. There is also a problem with elixir distribution and service.Worst game in the app store.

There is an algorithm in the game. After a certain place, the opponent starts to come according to your deck( in a bad way). The object of the game is to keep you in a certain trophy, or to make you spend as much time there as possible. So you have to spend money to go further because there are really annoying and very strong opponents coming (like 5 14 level cards in one deck at 5000 trophy). But it's a good game if you don't get greedy and play comfortably.

At first it was okay, but late-game, your credit card becomes the strongest card in the game. It takes a long time for chests to unlock, which gives you cards, which you need to upgrade your unit's level. These upgrades seem insignificant at first, but they actually do have a huge impact in higher arenas. Furthermore, you have to constantly fight people who would normally lose to you, had their cards not been at the max level. Overall, really hard to get max level cards, so 2 stars.

So many reasons why this game deserves a low rating. It had the perfect fundamentals, allowing people to play 2v2 with friends and progress through the game. Now your capped at 2 wins for almost no rewards, are their serious? Not only that but have decided to devalue the battle pass by up to 10-15x. What are the developers doing? LISTEN TO YOUR PLAYER BASE SUPERCELL! This game use to be and easy 5 star, amazing gameplay, good mutiplayer experiences. All for supercell to get greedy pockets... fix

I've been playing long time since the first release, after a year as a returning player, everything seems change, I don't even familiar with clan wars system last day i played, and it feels kinda mess up. This game has always been a pay-to-win game. It's definitely possible to get good playing free-to-play, as I am free-to-play and have gotten very high on ladder and high levek cards. With each update the game is getting bad but then came the update of the 'evoluations' after which it has become dead. No wonder now people don't play this.

It's fun until you reach a certain level, but then, it starts to get really annoying when you start to confront low level players with maxed out cards that they get through buying everything they can, making it a mismatch because sometimes there is no way to beat them, after a year of playing this, I'm getting bored just because of that

The new pass is a complete money grab. I think this game could use some large mass arena, or like a huge battle field like team deathmatch, I just think the diffrent modes with events in them ain't enough for my any more, but thats me and so far I do love the game. Its iconic with great character, but honestly I hate when somebody uses an overpowered push and I counter they just give up. I don't really care if nobody reads this. It's not bad. A Lot Of Grinding is needed. Lots of gold. I don't play often except when they have special mode such as infinite elixir, gold rush. In clan war, I enjoy the race mode, double elixir and ramp up etc. Don't like the sudden death or rage battle much. But other modes r pretty fun. I like variety of party mode. Also would be nice to have 2v2 in clan war and be able chat and plan before hand. Might take little time but would be interesting

This game used to be insanely fun but their new money making strategy has ruined everything. They release a new character which just "happens to be" overpowered, forcing you to pay €50 to have the card ready to use instantly for higher ranked battles. It used to not be as blatant, but after the new card 'goblin machine' released that was (again) "accidentally" game breaking, realising that I was yet to catch up with the last updates I finally closed the game for the last time and deleted it.

This is a genuinely good game. In fact I'd say it's one of the greatest mobile games I've ever played. HOWEVER this game, while better than clash of clans, is still a whale black hole. It is designed to make you want to constantly spend money, and it pushes this hard. They are perfectly happy to alienate their core f2p audience so that the few people who either can easily afford to spend and a few thousand doesn't matter to them, or who can't afford it but are vulnerable to addiction etc will.

I played this game for years and I decided to change my review. It is a real shame seeing this game fall into the pay-to-win mechanic so deep. There were always these little microtransactions, but they were predominantly for speeding up your progress and getting more cards to upgrade your deck. Your skill could always win you the game even if you are at a disadvantage. But now if you have not spent a fortune buying the latest evolutions you will not enjoy your time at all. Also nerf firecracker.

I enjoy this game a lot, and I play it every day(and have been for 7 or 8 months). I really enjoy the strategy aspect and how there are so many cards to experiment with and choose from. Unfortunately, as the game progresses, it becomes increasingly hard to progress yourself. On Trophy Road especially, I find myself getting matched into opponents with exceptionally higher level cards than mine. Though this game does require skill, people with 2 or 3 levels higher than you will destroy you.

When they released subscriptions, they said you'd get a second chance on events. I paid, but the extra chances didn't work most of the time. Contacted support and they said it's fine. Literally took my money and didn't provide the service they said they would. I haven't played in years. I downloaded the game after switching to Android from iphone just so I can leave a 1/5 review. Uninstalling right after posting this.

It's really a useless game. I as a level 11 player, I always met level 12 opponents with maxed cards' level in usual tropies battle and clan wars. How can I win? I haven't touched the game in two years. I started up again and honestly I'm in a purgatory. It's unbalanced at all. I've played this game before. And I've had issues before it too. But now, the whole gameplay is the issue, you just can't find an opponent who's a match to you. Even with a teammate, it's hard. Deck building game with some fun mechanics and quick gameplay. But make no mistake, until you have all level 13 cards it's pay to win. No matter how good you are you will hit a point where your opponents have an average deck of cards 2-3 levels higher than yours and they will win with just brute force. It also feels like it's nearing the end where they've designed themselves into a hole. Upping the max card level gives higher players something to work towards but it's just more grinding.

Because this ia an international format, i can't even abuse these guys. this is one of the best online strategy/card games I've played in my life. Gameplay is nice, graphics amazing, music engaging and matches very competitive. The pay to win is INSANE. The game is being managed in a terrible way, and they put more and more mechanics that makes the game unplayable if you don't put money on it. Now with over 100 cards theirs no strategy it just depends on who has the stronger deck. Sad to see an excellent game go so far downhill. Would give it zero if I could.

Been playing this game since 2016, never have I felt that this game has become more and more of a cash grab. this is a great game bogged down by an insane "card"system. Absolutely DO NOT PLAY. I've played this game for many years and have enjoyed it more than any other game on the mobile platform. When you start playing the game is really hard, but when you are a little more familiar with the game it is a great game to play. This game from a player's standpoint is they force you to play the "new cards" when they come out. If you don't you can't compete at the top levels. Eventually, they rebalance things but it's super frustrating to deal with. I will be quitting after playing for 6 years.

Don't download this game unless u plan on putting money into it. It is very much a "pay to play" game. The higher u get in the game the easier it is to see that. I've been playing for over a year and I still don't have all the legendaries. You will constantly get the same cards instead of cards you need. Not downloading this game is ur best bet.

Game itself is ok, but cheating is so rampant with 3rd party software that it's boring after going up just a few levels. Ok to try, but DON'T waste any money on it. adding level 15 may be what kills this game. This game used to be really good, but somehow supercell managed to completely screw it up. I play alot of diferent games, strategic, action, puzzles, etc this game however is great! Fast, easy and live online mutiplayer. Download. Game is fun but you guys really to need to work on the balancing issues. I think there should be something that can detect when you have a connection issue and doesn't make you lose trophies. Still recommend getting the game though

As much as I had fun playing this game, I'm reminded why I uninstall it every time. I don't have a lot of disposable income so unless you plan on actually dropping some good money early on, dont bother with this game. It suffers from some heinous pay to win practices, dont believe the lies they say, the legendary cards carry games and there's nothing you can do if you get behind even a bit. It's great starting out when there aren't too many cards to unlock but once you get higher up if you don't stay on top of unlocking cards you will have a horrible time grinding loss after loss just to try to get the daily crown chest. If you got money to burn great it's really fun but if you don't want to actually spend a lot of money to stay competitive dont bother.

So this game is decent. No doubt about that. The concept is great. But the game is becoming predictable and repetitive. Everybody uses the same things. Players in a losing side might just disconnect and connect to stall. Maybe you can only lag out twice before they cannot use it anymore. Consider please.

I really really love this game. Ive been playing it for years, and ive recently peaked in trophies. This takes card game to another level. While it is not fully like solitaire or spades, the card aspect really fits in well with the game. Player of 6+ years. WAS a solid game with satisfying gameplay and strategy that WAS understandable. My problem regards the present state of the game. No one who works on the development team for this game has ever played this game. I've had the Clash for 3 years and its been really fun to play with mates and everything the reason I gave it 4 stars though is because of me not being able to find the right clan and emote spammers in-game. The game is extremely pay to win, as a casual player I don't enjoy playing the game anymore. game was kinda fun but it had this recurring glitch were every time I entered a match I would get a "wait a moment error" forcing me to watch myself lose while I could not place any cards down on the field. EXTREMELY PAY TO WIN; don't think about trying to reach the top without spending at least 100s of dollars bc of the horrible progression, the cards are annoying, and also is home to one of the most toxic communities. The game was already lowkey dead and broken, but after the update it's now fully underground dead. Totally atrocious decisions made. This last update is awful, you get the season pass badge everywhere, not just in the store. It feels like an app with ads (Btw, I hate apps with ads). Easy, fun, and it will hook you in one go. Just a super game people.. That top line was me, 3 years back, but lately, my app always crash during the second or third match. Great game, well balanced cards with updates every 2 weeks. Been playing for 6 years. Simply, the core game is very good. Yeah there are timers, but you can always still play for fun, gold and trophies. Need even more reliable and a easy way to view the card collection.Though there is a filter to use, it still makes me to find particular cards difficult to build the decks. Horrible pay to win game. Matchmaking is broken. I either get opponents two king tower levels above me, with cards around two levels above anything I have, or opponents with decks perfectly matched to mine. What I don't see that often is an opponent who is evenly matched to me, either in king/card level or in deck layout. It seems the game is tilted in favor of those who want to spend a bunch of money to level up their cards. Otherwise, there's no progress to be made. One of the worst cash grab games on the market after recent update. Slowed progression down to an all time low nerfed the gold pass and double the price for it. Game has gone down hill so much and it's a shame.

Supercell should take it down a few notches and let the game be itself without force.

Horrible, truly one of the worst games that you wanna have fun with. Terrible matchmaking, being paired up with opponents that have cards that are higher level than yours. They gutted the battle pass and trippled the price. They keep adding levels despite no one wanting more levels, and they refuse to balance cards that have been problematic for MONTHS

This game is so unfair once you get uo to the "last" arena, where it just becomes a series of more arenas.
