I've played this game since 2013. Out of all the supercell games I've played in my life, this one is the most disappointing and a blatant cash grab now. It used to be very skill based with each card having specific abilities to counter such card with another, like overwatch. But overtime with the introduction of lvl 15 cards and evolutions, resources are harder to acquire via free to play more than ever. You used to be able to get insane value with the "battle pass" for $5. Half that for $12 now

This game is terrible. When I play, the 70% of the time the game tells me that something went wrong in the middle of a fight, that gives the enemy advantages because, in that space of time that I am spending on trying to solve the problem of that "something went wrong" the enemy can easily win because I'm not playing. Never play this game because for sure you're going to loose all the time.

Im in the stage of trying to find a good deck. I notice that when I finally get a good deck figured out, Ill play with it and win a little. But then, the opponents will start using the same EXACT decks as one another that perfectly counter mine over and over again. The actual weird thing is that all of the opponents have very basic names like "hugo" and "nikol" and in no clan. I make zero in game transactions. My friends do, however, and do not experience this. I feel the enemies are bots.

This was a wonderful, yet challenging, game. Especially the recent update has made it a completely pay to win game. I was angry and while back since I had 4k trophies and an update made it to where I needed 5k trophies to be done with the arena. I don't remember what it was called. That made me stop playing for around two years. I tried it again yesterday and I feel like this game is hopeless. I mean honestly now we have level locked characters? All in all, I most likely won't be playing again.

Gotta pay to play Unless you buy their stuff, they throttle you like cell service; which, of course, impacts your ability to play successfully. This is a fun game, but when you play your pieces you expect them to actually load right away; not several seconds later when it's too late. Other players I know who. buy their stuff have quick loading game play. Sad that this is what this developer has stooped to.

great game, only issue is connectivity. if you experience any connection issue your game stalls and nothing moves, you cant place anything. as soon as you get "connection" back, the game is sped up to catch up to where the game is during the disconnection. there should be a stop in play for both parties if there is a connection issue to keep it fair. trying to beat your buddies gets tough when you get stupid issues like this...

Since the crashing issue has been foxed, I am now happy to give this game 5 stars. The graphics are simple, though quite charming. The controls are very simple and easy to learn. The game does have microtransactions, and though they do speed up progress, I don't think they give you a significant advantage over F2P players like myself. Updates are consistent and new content and events are being added all the time. Definitely pick this one up if you've never tried it.

I played this game for over 7 years. Throughout, i spent around 300€ on various microtransactions. I returned to the game recently after years of inactivity and I was having fun. After a few games, my opponent dropped a level 15 card and I instantly quit the game and removed it. I would need to pay 300€ just to not be in a disadvantage again. If you aren't ready to pay absurd amounts of money for this free to play game, be ready for hours of frustration. Avoid this product like a plague

Basically they just want to try to get as much money out if you as possible. Yea I'm sure if you want to play this game for years without spending money you might actually get some max level cards but you'll spend most of your time frustrated that people just have max level everything somehow in the lower trophy range(lower levels of play) Basically they dont care about balance and try to get you to spend a bunch to be competitive.

This game got a lot less fun since they've started phasing out the 2v2 battles. In the past they had multiple modes for 2v2 which would change regularly. Recently they took away almost all of those options and made the button for 2v2 mode super hard to find. 2v2 was most of what I liked about Clash Royale, I really liked it and thought it was an awesome game. I would play it a lot with my partner, and even buy the pass royale. I think taking away 2v2 was a bad idea and will lose many players.

i think the pay to win thing is additional, but now in most of the games It has become essential, especially in this rotten game. I mean, if you remove the boxes and the store, how does one develop? In addition, whoever does not pay money will be literally slapped on the back of the head. I mean, one can keep quiet about the evo cards thing in first, but like now? it is literally impossible to play. very bad update, and very bad game in general im just playing for the old memories.

This game use to be awesome back when it first came out, if they would've just quit adding nonsense and micro transactions it probably would still be a top 10 game. But Supercell is known for ultra-micro-transactions. Recently downloaded it again and it's extremely unbalanced, you can't run a favorite deck because there's only 3 decks you can win with unless you are pro. Very sad to see a favorite of mine turn into a straight dumpster fire of a game.

Match making system is completely messed up and it's simply hit or miss. Time to time you get the same level opponents to get you hooked and after that it starts matching you with 3 times more advanced players which are impossible to beat. Oh and the "best" part is that no matter how many times you report it inside the game, no one gives a damn.

Once again I came back and now the matchmaking is clearly made to force you to buy stuff since the decks are made to counter you. This could be fun but it is every match. Also the new system makes it hard to move up. Since most of the time the person is 3 to 5 levels above you, it makes it an not so fun game. I played this game on and off for 5 years and now I am giving up for good since they only want your money and no longer care about the people.

Don't install this game. First of all, the matchmaking is rigged, favoring whoever benefits the least from winning a game. It may be easy at first to progress, but the further you go, the harder it gets to progress without spending money. Some decks are just broken, and the devs refuse to do anything about it. And they're even cracking down the value you get from buying items in the store, as well as the pass royale. Recent updates have only made this worse and worse, don't start playing this!

This update killed the game for me. I played for 9 years, but with the removal of chests, season shop, win streaks, etc there is no point in me logging on every day. or ever. Now it's just cash offers in every nook and crevice of the game. I can overlook a lot of things, but there is no fun in this game anymore.

Like any other pay to win game it's fun at first then you get to level 7-8 and you are stuck if you play without buying gems. You could 'out-strategize' your opponent and his purchased armies will still roll right over you. Sounds fun right? Also, the servers drop signal periodically. Also, they have formulas for pairing decks up against opponents i.e. if you have a Giant, you opponents will have some anti-giant card to make them competitive.

Do not play if you frustrate easily. I used to enjoy this game quite a lot. It was neither too easy nor too hard. It had become practically impossible to advance in levels. There are times when you lose for 8 or 9 games in row simply because you are paired with people that are so over powered in comparison. It says to take a break if you find yourself in a losing streak. By that standard, I would never play more than a round, maybe 2, any given day.

It's a fun game, but I keep getting matched up with other players with cards from several arenas ahead of me. I'm in arena 7 and lost to someone with barbarian hut and giant skeleton. I have made more progress but it is unplayable because I have 1 legendary while people have 4-5 in their deck. Please do something about this. This game is not fun. I do not recommend. It has died off. I would rate 0 if it was possible

Fun To play. A lot of people say it's unfair and you have to buy stuff. But I had to start all over with nothing because I forgot my password on an old account and I climbed back to tower lvl. 11 and the level with the two gold swords crossing in like 2 or 3 months. I just recently started getting the pass to speed up the process cause you get extra rewards. So I don't believe you have to buy stuff or that it's unfair. You just have to be add and good at video games.

I'll never understand why elixir isn't at the same rate when you're in a battle! You will usually know within a few seconds whether or not you even have a chance when your opponent is dropping twice the amount of energy as you can. It sucks when you are playing against a weaker opponent and you can't even counter because of how slow your meter is filling compared to them. Something needs to change

At first it is a nice game, but then it is all about spending a lot of money to upgrade your level or losing a lot of time to do it. Change strategy is a pain because of that. You can only test your real skills in events which balances your cards, and even those requires you to spend money. It also has a lot of delays, even with good cellphone and internet.

The game is now unplayable. If you manage to make it to 3600 trophies you're stuck and can't go backwards. That means you're stuck with all the above average or pay-to-play players who kill you in every match. This makes it impossible to progress unless you also pay or grind chests for weeks/months to try and get a foothold up to 3800 trophies. How pathetic. Get rid of the update so we can go backwards and hone our skills so we can try to progress.

started playing I'm December of 2022. bought like 3 battle passes and it was really fun. the passes were helping me make steady progress and then the battle pass update came out. the pass was stripped of a bunch of value and it was bad for the game. kept playing anyway and then evolutions and lvl 15 updates came. They are awful. The leaders of this group ruined their game over about a 10 month period. it's a 1 star now, not even in the top 50 downloaded apps. it was in the top 10 a year ago

Not fun, but addicting. The new Clan Wars II is very uninteresting, complicated and aimed towards hard-core players. Cooldowns are too high, matchmaking in the whole game is a nightmare, people pay to win, the addition level 14 is stupid, and the navigation of the clan menu is terrible now. I hope they revert to the first Clan Wars and fix the game entirely because it is utterly broken. Also, SuperCell's account security is terrible and one of my accounts got hacked. Whats happening???

This game was by far the best game ever made. It was competitive but it was fair, right now it's just a scam. There are players who I don't know if they have the game hacked or if they have some trick for the elixir, but while I can only throw one card, they throw up to three high elixir cards, how is it possible? I have bought offers in-game store I have spent a lot of money and I continue to lose as if my cards have no improvement. I'm not going continue paying for lose to cheaters.

This game is great, the graphcis are nice, and gentle, and the concept, and overall time while playing the game is enjoyable. But i do not recommend it to anyone who is new. The games ranking system works with trophies that are deducted or increased upon a victory or a loss. That pretty much means that the majority of players intentionally lose to combat players of less experience, so unless you can break through that first threshold or drop some money, I don't recommend this game.

Clash Royale has suffered a severe drop in user experience, clan war gutting with level 15 being twice that of 14 to reach and evolutions being behind a 100 dollar purchase. The battle pass is not anywhere near the value it's asking for. Many offers in the store are scams "x10 value." The actual game is still solid but has awful balancing on evolutions, becoming a buy-in if you want to compete. I no longer recommend this game to others until these issues are addressed.

I mean... it's a great way to kill some time, but I'm just not really part of its target audience. Don't get me wrong tho. It's a great game and has a good UI but my problem is is that I want quick results. This means of coarse that it feals like I'm starving to death when waiting for a chest to open and that I'm more of a console/pc gamer. Still a good game

Its a great game to begin with, however, it would take years to reach the final level, unless your willing to spend real money on it. Basically once you hit level 10, the progression system becomes 'pay to win'. Also if you're exceptionally good at this game you basically get punished by being teamed up with opponents a much higher level than you, which is no fun at all. I quit the game at level 10 due to constantly being teamed up with level 13's, which is extremely unbalanced and unfair.

Forgot how bad it was until I played it again. In the lead? You opponent seems to comeback almost every single time like they recharge elixir faster than you. Want to get higher ranks? We'll give you opponents who've maxed out everything. Follow advice for making a good deck? You're opponent seems to always counter everything you try to do. The bots and hackers in this game are awful and that saying something being a Dead by Daylight player. Impossible to enjoy and just plain frustrating.

It's a great game, actually, but in this new update, it became so pay 2 win that it got unplayable. every 2 matches, I get a battle pass oponent that has at least 2 level 16 cards and completely destroys strategies that would work normally to counter the card. it's probably the most pay 2 win game I've ever played, and I really liked it before it became this, but now it's just disappointing to see how greedy supercell is.

I don't understand why there is a ranked option where you are limited by the level of your cards. It destroys competitive integrity because it really doesn't matter after a while if you just don't have high level cards. The game is fun, but it is extremely frustrating and unfun to see the enemy have the same cards as you, just several levels higher, and knowing you'll lose because your cards are just worse.

By far the worst pay to win game I had ever played. You have absolutely no chance against someone who has spent money, on it. Its virtually impossible for a casual player to enjoy. SuperCell got carried away with earning money, thus making the matchmaking the worst part of it. You can't do anything against a level 10, or higher when your just an average player. Download this if you want to pull your hair out.

The game can be fun and rewarding, such as playing challenges and unlocking achievements/ magic items to help you progress. However, everything that you earn through time & effort can simply be purchased with real money. You can become skilled & learn to play with your cards & decks, but alas, if your opponent has spent more money, your odds of winning are slim. Often letting the player feeling very stressed and overall a sour experience that doesnt want you to keep playing for more.

Not worth it, once you reach 5000+ trophies it is going to be a hell for you. League resets like anything, the opponent comes with higher level cards and clash royale makes sure you loose the game. They try to show you that it is not possible to win and also will show you that you can buy everything. I hate to play this game after 5000 trophies as it is not fair, to spend time. I spend days going to challenger 2 and one reset brought me back to challenger 1, what is the point to a golden step.

I used to love this game. I even used watched content creaters. But it seems now everything is just a mess. They've added way too much. Daunting.

Takes forever to load into the game. When it finally does load in and i go to the shop the game freezes for over a minute. When i load into a match it also takes forever, so by the time it's finished loading the enemy has already destroyed one of my towers. All of this makes for a fun experience.

Love the game. Have had it for a couple years. Solid community etc. However...the new clan wars style is absolutely ruining the game. It was good until they changed it. Also it is becoming more of a pay to win than it was a couple years ago. Matchmaking also needs some serious work. Once you get to challenger 3 the card levels of opponents is often 13 or gold, and you have level 10 and 11. At that point you wave a white flag. I did rate it a 4 or 5 star game until this. Sorry

The game is fun, but after some time it becomes very clear who is paying and who isn't, if you climb far enough eventually you run into people who are the same level as you, but thier units are much higher level. I could get away with beating higher level units, and I thought fair enough, since I didn't pay I'm a bit weaker ok, but now they introduced evolutions, and I think they remove skill expression, you either have them or don't, and if you don't pay, it'll take months to get them.

Says update and you cant. Had max cards and now they come out with level 14 is pretty sad. There is no point in making us upgrade every card again. Some cards are so over powered. No skill. No strategy. This was my favorite game for years. Now I can tell you in the first 5 seconds who will win. Sometimes before my cards even appear they have already played a card. I can win 6 games in a row one day and loss 10 in a row the next day. It has nothing to do with your skills. Im just about done with this "game"

This game's algorithm works as when you don't purchase anything then you won't progress much. As if you'll win 2 matches in row then top level of player will come against you. The most important part of this game is the opponents matching which is not working fair. I played the game long time ago for a long time and end up to uninstall it and now I gave it a try and it's still the same. What is the meaning of the game when it matches a level 3 to a level 6 tower with also much higher card levels? You need to pay money to win, otherwise the matching system will significantly make it harder to advance.

Had a problem and contacted customer service through their in-game messaging app to recover my account. You can't outplay someone who's got higher level cards and there's no catch up mechanic besides mega $$$. Sure cards are capped at 9 for tournaments but I can't level cards up quickly so I'm still 2 to 3 levels behind. It's pay to win if you're new. NTY.

Clash Royale is hands down one of the most fun and addictive games I’ve ever played! The mix of real-time strategy, unique cards, and constant updates keeps the game fresh and exciting. Supercell really nailed it with this one!

this game is alright, I started playing on release and at one point I took a break from the game for a few years. In the beginning it was the best game I had ever played on my phone. Now though connection during just about every game is terrible. Sometimes the game doesn't even load. don't install it if you can't spend a lot of money on this game because each new update makes players to spend more money. I've been playing for yeeaars now. The game is good but the way they extort money is very bad. As someone who has played since day 1, I feel qualified to say this game isn't what it used to. You can only get so far without having to pay money to keep up. the only ones that will give this game a high review now are the wallet warriors and the new players, this game has devolved from a decent game to a very much pay to win/advance, every screen in the game wants you to buy something, the game is throttled for non players, though supercell will of course denigh this, but the increasing number of low ratings so I'm not the only one that thinks this, the higher up you go in the game the more unbalanced it becomes, level 11 players will expect to go against level 12 and 13 opponents with maxed out cards on a regular basis, I started a new run just to see what the lower levels are like now and found the game play to be the same, my lvl 2 account was pitted against lvl 3 and 4 accounts with cards that were level 4, 5 and 6 cards against my lvl 2 and 3 cards. if not for the years of play and all the money I used to put in to this game I would delete it right now as I no longer enjoy playing and play more as a habit although the more pay to win and advance it becomes the closer I get to just saying FK IT,

Didn't keep any of my progress from my Ipod which I longer have. Have to start at level 1 and it takes 6 years if playing everyday to unlock any of the new or fun stuff. Thanks Supercell, you just destroyed one of my favorite game...

I've played this game since 2016 when the Princess was the first legendary, and the game has been going downhill. Evolutions, P2W mechanics and the shop being over run with countless "great deals!" The game has become a nightmare, filled with overpowered cards and the true strategy is now just lost. Spam evolutions until you win, or spend money to max out every card you have. It's not like it was back then, and I wish it would change.

Very disappointing. My son somehow accidentally bought in-game currency, twice in less than a second. Seems scammy that can happen onxe, let alone twice. But worse still, when requesting a refund, they offered a refund but only if he agreed to lose his account. Extortion much? Sheesh, no amount of money is enough for some people. Always have to stick it to people.

I used to love playing this game. I was level 10 and had every legendary in the game. But recently I've had this recurring issue. My game will start a match and 15 seconds into the match, it freezes. I've dropped from 3540 trophies to 2190. And I know it's not my device. I've tried multiple devices like the LG v20 but I'm still getting this bug. Please fix it so I (and many others) can go back and playing the game we play and love.

Used to be very addicting making decks and using them. However, after gaining a certain amount of trophies, you reach a point where your cards are 2-4 levels below everyone else's, so you constantly lose. You aren't rewarded with gold to level up your troops if you lose, and you can't drop trophies (to play people at your level) if you lose either, so you're stuck. Then it becomes a grind to get wins and gold to level up your cards. When you reach this point the game isn't fun anymore.

I've played the game for a very long time and can say without a doubt, it's been fun. Unfortunately with the recent update with "pass royale", it became clear to me what direction supercell has decided to take. The new update has left tons of bugs and introduced a 6 dollar super boost to instantly decrease the time it takes to get Legendaries and the sort, oppose to having to earn them through heard work and motivation. I can say that this game has passed it's peak, don't bother installing.

The game has become EXTREMELY sticky since the July update of 2019. By which u mean it will lag in the middle of matches, on the menu screen, when I'm trying to change from the store tab to the deck tab, not to mention the incredibly long wait times for the app to launch. I also get tossed into the middle of games when I'm trying to start one, and 1 if not both of my crown towers is already destroyed. I've been playing for 3 years, and clearing space won't work. Like if this is happening to you!

I love playing Royale when it will load. Sometimes it tries to load and goes into a loop of loading and restarting. It will load to 50%; then it will go back to the supercell screen. Wash rinse repeat. Frustrating. I quit playing for a while. Came back to the game. Similar problems. The game is lots of fun but it will freeze in the middle of the match.

The game has a good concept, but it seems unbalanced which makes it so incredibly frustrating to the point where playing more just seems pointless, throughout your progress, you're constantly matched with people (most likely AI) that have higher card levels, which in turn slows your progress even more. Of course, if you're willing to pour money into it, you can level up and get the OP cards.

💩! This is how i would describe this game. You will be playing against bots 98% of the time and those bots will always have the better team. And, not only that! Your bot opponents have the ability to change more than 8 warriors during a single game!!!

Used to be a huge fan of the game but now I feel like they have tried to make everyone happy and have rigged the game in the process. (Update) It seems that party mode is gone. Incredibly good, interesting, fun and balanced game but the company has become increasingly greedier. The most recent update gutted the progression for casual players, forcing them to play the main competitive mode if they want any rewards at all for playing. Along with the same update reducing rewards from the battle pass and challenges, makes for a very poor experience. I would absolutely recommend playing this a year ago, but now I would recomend staying away from it.

The game was killed by the update. The update ruined the fun aspect(s) of the game; 2v2. You no longer earn chests OR crowns from anywhere but ladder. Lower level players can now unlock champions as well, and it's locked behind a pay wall, giving paying players a huge advantage. The pass also costs $1 more and gives less, while having an option that gives the same as the old pass, but for $12. A $7 increase!

Fast, fun, and competitive game play. Easy to get hooked once you give it a try, but then there are the downsides. The lag in matches have gotten a lot worst, you can load into a match late at no fault of your own; have an up to date device, a strong stable Wi-Fi, and enough free memory will not save you from it. For a game that supposed to be competitive, how can you market this for an esport when you can load in 10sec or more late?

The game is a total time killer. It's fun and has great game play with no delay or bugs or any of those stuff. The game is practically perfect except for the fact that you have to wait 3 Hours if not more for a better chest. Even when I'm full, I play cause it's that addicting but I'm not making any progress. Getting higher in trophies but not having the troops for it. I don't want to wait 3 Hours to play one match that makes the addiction characteristic part of the game useless

Update:. Broken! I keep getting a pop up that says "ERROR!  Client and server are out of sync!" The only option is to reload which doesn't fix. I tried to uninstall and reinstall but still broken. It was decent during my 2.5 years of play, but I can clearly see some issues. Don't get me wrong, the seasons are great, with magic items making upgrading easier, the game seems to be good. Good at first, looks like it had great potential, however it falls short for a multitude of reasons that I cannot fit in this review sadly. It was a decent game but recent updates made the gameplay more grind-ish and annoying overall, with several heavy penalizations to the players' progress both for pay-to-win and, specially, free-to-play ones. Just uninstalled the app, there's something wrong with the algorythm. Sometimes when you use the characters, instead of taking the left they take the right. the game was, and still looks really fun to play, and i have fond memories of battling with my clanmates, but the agressive monetization and exorbitant prices for something as basic as an emote or gold in the shop was too much, and i've stopped playing for almost a year by now, and currently don't think on returning anytime soon.

The game is great. A great strategy game that you have to have a chess mind for. Also the challenges and team games are fun. There is a bit of pay to win elements though. Also I have uninstalled a couple of times because of the game changing my cards. It is rare but it is frustrating during matches. Other than that the game is pretty good. If the pay to play and glitches were smoothed out then I would give 5 stars.

I like the game so much not until when Im getting a winning streak, the opponent will get stronger, like my tower is just level 10 and most of my opponents are in level 11 and 12, sometimes it's level 13 towers. SUPERCELL JUST WANTS YOUR MONEY! I'm playing the game since it came out in 2016. Long gone is the time when this used to be a skill game, now it's all pay to win. The game is no doubt good. There's a lot of possibilities when it comes to future development. Mechanics, features and all (elemental advantages, spell defense, structure-unit interaction) . Things I wish were better: I hate that teammates can bail out on you in a 2v2. Consecutive games like that can get frustrating. I also wish there were more communication options. Strategizing messages, co-op, etc. Personally I even want a message for when teammates leave matches. Also crown tower growth 😬

The game is pretty straight forward and would be a lot of fun if it wasn't a pay to win game. Unless you drop loads of cash to max out your cards, you'll get stuck in middling levels forever. Which means no new cards for a very long time. Events would be a cool alternative but that gets expensive too if you ever want to win there. And the 2v2? It's horribly random.

Good game but the way how they manage updates and introduce new features were horrible.1. There were too many bugs. At least one disconnection around 15 battles. Wanted to sent message to supercell by last time they didnt bother to respond so there is no need for me to do that. 3. Slow compare to the first year of release. Slow load, slow game play. Used to enjoy the game, but got really frustrated with the constant push to buy passes. It became nearly impossible to grind out upgrades. Fun game to play but every now and then some problems pop up that wont go away. Game keeps getting stuck while opening chests. Game abruptly restarts during intense matches at times. The game is quick and fun, you need to use strategy and you'll battle many different kinds of people. I tried the uninstall/ reinstall method, same thing.

Was originally a five star a couple years ago, now, as everyone states, it is severely a pay to win deal. I get when some skill can come into play, but now it is simply just pay to wins and bad luck. I don't mind when money is spent on a game, but don't make it to where it ruins the experience for everyone. Most of the time I am always countered by cards that are higher leveled than me, and not by a small amount mind you, by a few levels and "stars" at that.

Still fun, but used to be a lot more simple and straightforward... they keep demotivating the long time players by making it easier and easier to obtain stuff. We spent the time building up to what we have, and it feels so unfair that the new players just can come in and collect gold and level up their decks in such short time. The game felt more fair prior in this regard.

Addictive and fun, sometimes it can seem rigged, but the fan base is huge and for that they have a very active staff constantly changing the game to balance power and fix any issues that may pop up. there are tons of YouTube videos as well. I've had this game for 2 years now with no plans on uninstalling, and I've barely put any cash into it whatsoever yet I'm a single level/arena away from the world tournaments. it's just a great strategy game.

I started playing again after a long time since I got busy with college. This issue is stuck in a loop and I tried to clear cache and data, as well as reinstalling the game (twice!) Even as I start making this review I encounter a ton of other reviews about Clash Royale becoming a P2W game. I'm suddenly unsure if I want to play this game again.

Eventually the game became not worth the time or grind! Play the game knowing it'll be fun in the beginning, but you'll have to invest heavy or you won't be able to go against other people you face!
many game in my mphone no one delay and lost connection many time like this game.

Used to love this game, and played it a ton and had fond memories. Do yourself a big favor and steer wide clear of this game in the modern era. It's only going downhill.

It could definiteley be a good game if it didn't stop and close itself every three seconds and if instead of constantly saying there is no signal when I get three bars with LTE and also when I go and play a 2v2 it closes and when I go and open it up again it loads up to 50% and re-loads without fail every time not allowing me to even enter the game. The game has seemed to take a turn for the worse. I deal with so much latency (mainly during the challenges and war) that it makes it extremely difficult staying competitive. Everything is great. I love this game. It has evolved so much than before. Just one issue though. For some reason, the tips that are shown at the matchmaking screen are not completely visible. The game has been moving from skill based to pay to play. You're pretty limited in your progression until you start to spend money. For example, the 5 dollar monthly subscription which gives you double the awards and more than double the value of what you would usually earn progressing freely. It is a great game overall and I'm a few years in veteran

Fun game.Addictive.Takes long time to level up. Edit: After 4 years I have to say the game is now trash. After you get to the high ranks it can take months to upgrade a card. Everyone you play literally just waits until you play so they can set up a perfect combo that you cant counter. Then you wait 30 seconds and they do it again. Also the progression stops. Once you get to 5000 trophies everyone has max level cards and if you go on a win streak, you will go on a lose streak. Negative trophies

I've played all the clash games for a couple of years, this one is the most unstable and frustrating to play. Constant freezes and crashes during play. Once they banned me for an hour because they thought I was leaving the game intentionally. Ive rebooted phone and WiFi router, hasn't helped. Finally uninstalled and reinstalled game, waiting to see what happens. Decided to leave review for others. I like the game but if this reinstall doesn't work it's gone. I don't have these issues with boom Beach or clash of clans.

The whole point of this game is to get people to spend money. It's only enjoyable if you have maxed out meta cards, and even then, the matching algorithm makes you lose enough to never truly climb until you've pumped some more money in. My advice: like all addictions, you'll wish you wouldn't have started. It's fun at first but when you get good at it, it'll get the better of you.

Pay for play, just stay away! Used to be fun but they constantly tweak it and have ruined the experience. Older cards are weakened (mega knight) and newer cards are too powerful (electro giant). Plays extremely slow at times where your opponent will be able to play cards more quickly putting you at a significant disadvantage. If you don't spend $ on it you'll be ok, if you do it will be a complete waste as whatever you invest in will be tweaked until it's useless causing you to spend more.

It is a very fun game from the start... Then you get to higher arenas and it just becomes this pay to win system where skill doesn't even matter and it's just about having high levels and all of the new cards on release, it's a shame really, and now they added pass Royale to even further the pay to win aspect of the game. Once you get 5k trophies just stop playing unless you want to spend money.

This game is so much fun, one of the most addictive games I've played on a phone, or even in general. Unfortunately, as many reviews have stated it takes WAY too long to open up the chests, however I don't agree with people when they say that ruins the game, you can always still earn trophies/achievements even when your chest slots are full. And when it is I play just to earn them and improve my skill level and find the right team combinations. I also expirence connection problems I would say about 30%

Rigged matchmaking and pay-to-win biased. At first, the game looks balanced and fine, but the more you progress on the ladder, the more difficult it gets. Not because of players and cards, but because matchmaking is unfair - either the game puts you against a player that is 2 level higher than you or against someone who has season pass and clearly has an advantage. I really like this game, I've played for more than 3 years, but now I've decided to stop playing definitively. The game algorithm is so deceptive that when you're on a loosing streak it doesn't matter how many decks you switch, how many legendary and combos you use, and how much time you spent without playing it, you'll always face someone with a deck that's perfect for neutralizing yours. There comes a point you realise it's designed to make you lose more than win. To make you feel frustrated in order to trigger you to buy season pass and all the pay-to-win nonsense. I've never spent a penny on this, and I wish more people did the same and boycott. It gets worse year after year. 3/5

It was great at first. I really enjoyed the game and quickly rose up the ladder. It was exciting and fun, for a time. Once I reached max level I started to really struggle to level up my cards and it has become worse with more cards and the same little rewards. I didnt see it much when I was lower level and lower on the ladder, but they really emphasize the spend money to stay competitive feature. I cant fault them, it is a business at the end of the day, but it killed my fun.

It is very painful that I open the application and let me play "normal" 4 or 5 games, after those games it starts to go slow and bug at the start of the game the screen does not work and the troops on the contrary they begin to move in fast motion and in one demolish my towers without allowing me to attack. and not only that, there are times when the screen freezes for minutes and when defrosting, I'm back on the menu of the app, losing 20-30 trophies or bug and make my phone reboot alone.

I wish they didn't have to "even" up the leveling system in the cards. i was so hype to keep track of my card levels and show them off to friends, but now, all of my friends and I have no use in trying to compete now. This game is a fast paced strategy game and is addicting....but when you have come so far as legendary arena...you realise this game is notmade for free to play players cards will be added overpowered to entice people to buy them but after a few months in some cases weeks they're nerfed so even pay to win players get screwed

Constant crashes piss me off to no end, I shouldn't have to buy a new phone just so I can play a game (and it worked well before, so why the problems now?). 4 out of 5 times I lose because I get kicked out, have to log in again, or the game freezes. The game's great but the battles are almost always against someone who's at least 3 levels ahead of me... Terrible experience since past 2 days. My internet is top speed , every video, every app works flawlessly. But this game just loses connection every now and then and then just basically hangs. Good game I guess but, now that level 14 is here. It's hard to level up and get to a next level when you'll randomly get matched with a guy 4 levels above you or more. Fun, but ever since season three the first match I play when I open the app takes about 30 seconds to load, and in real matches I would have already lost by them so I need to always need to start a training mode match. I used to play it a lot more a couple of years ago, the problem imo is that at a certain point after clearing the "normal" arenas, it gets really hard to stay competitive. This is one of the best multiplayer games. And it needs brain too. Tactical. Nice graphics and features. News Royale is also up to date and interesting. And the best part is it loads quickly. I loved this game, I downloaded it as soon as it came out. After time I uninstalled because I had no time to play. I re-downloaded it to play and see how fun it is. I've been playing this game for a few years now and have been through many of the changes and updates. Some I thought were great, while others missed the mark. Clash Royale offers a pay-for-progress, but that doesn't necessarily mean victory. Players that choose to play for free are still capable of achieving the same end goals as players that pay, albeit at a much slower pace. In individual matches, both the free and pay-for-play players are effectively on a balanced playing field creating a thrilling and competitive environment. I was a free player and over the course of the previous few years, have been slowly progressing up the ladder and upgrading my cards to remain competitive at the higher levels. Understandably, as you get closer to the top, progress slows down considerably, but doesn't stop completely. For a free player like myself, it's annoying but manageable. Enter update December 2018. Supercell unveiled a number of changes that seem to target their paying customers (I don't fault them, just an observation). However, a side effect is my already slow progress has slowed even further. Combined with the almost monotonous gameplay (facing streaks with multiple different opponents that are all rocking the same exact deck) that I've experienced for the last 9-12 months, it is a little too much for me. It's been fun, but I've reached my natural end game and it's time for me to walk away.
